apprenticeship position. Indicative entry requirements are given below, but please note that each employer may set their own criteria. A Levels GCSE's Eligibility How to apply Three A Levels at CCC or above including a Mathematics based subject and a STEM subject, or equivalent BTEC. *Please note: Employers may specify their own entry criteria that can exceed this. Candidates who do not have three A Levels at CCC may be considered on a case by case basis with aptitude and experience taken into consideration. Read more » Have a minimum of five GCSEs at Grade C/4 or above including Mathematics, English and a science, technology or engineering related subject. Read more » Indicative entry requirements are given below, but please note that each employer may set their own criteria. University eligibility: Apprentices are selected based on their applications, an interview and an assessment process which is tailored to your apprenticeship position. Apprentice eligibility: The eligibility for the apprenticeship is set by DFE funding rules each year (please click here to read more). Read more » If you are already employed in this industry, you should discuss with your manager if your organisation is working in partnership with Aston University. If they are, you will make an application through your employer. If your employer is not yet an Aston partner, they can get in touch with our Apprenticeship Team to find out more information about working with us. Read more » Course fees You will not have to pay tuition fees as a Degree Apprentice, as the costs are met by the UK government and your employer*. In addition to your fees being paid, you will also earn a salary while you study, so there is no need to apply for Student Finance. The funding band for this degree apprenticeship is £27,000. This is the full cost of your apprenticeship which will be paid for using your employer's apprenticeship levy. Assessment For students By successfully completing this programme, you will be awarded a BSc in Digital Technology Solutions. You will also achieve an apprenticeship certificate that is graded at pass, merit or distinction. Each six month block of modules requires up to two days for examinations. Your employer will know about these days well in advance and will give you study leave so you can prepare. You will also be assessed through coursework, project reports, group projects and presentations. As part of the apprenticeship, you will undergo an end-point assessment to achieve the government approved Standard for a Digital and Technology Solutions Degree Apprenticeship. For employers Each six month block of modules requires up to two days on campus for examinations in addition to teaching days. Apprentices will also be assessed through coursework, project reports, group projects and presentations. As part of the apprenticeship, the candidate will undergo an end-point assessment to achieve the government approved Standard for a Digital and Technology Solutions Degree Apprenticeship. Career prospects If you're a prospective IT enthusiast aiming to acquire fresh skills and an official degree, this apprenticeship programme is tailored to your needs. Its purpose is to cultivate individuals who are imaginative, forward-thinking, and aspire to emerge as upcoming pioneers in both technical and business domains. Choose from five specialist pathways: Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Cyber Security, Networking Engineer, and Software Engineering. . Contact us If you have any questions, please email apprenticeships@aston.ac.uk. Be sure to include your name, your employer, and the programme you are inquiring about. Location: Aston University, Birmingham Apply now Agent application Register your interest Course type Full-time Entry requirements UK 2:2 honours degree or international equivalent Duration One year Start date January 2027 September 2027 Course overview Course description Course objectives Modules Facilities Entry requirements Fees and scholarships Apply now Agent application Register your interest GUARANTEED INTERNSHIPS WITH EVERY MASTER'S DEGREE Find out more Course overview The MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme at Aston University is among the first in the UK to focus on digital applications within chemical engineering. Designed for forward-thinking engineers, the course equips you with cutting-edge skills in digital tools, data-driven decision-making and sustainable process design. Taught by leading academics and industry experts, you will explore advanced topics like digital twins, machine learning and process simulation. You’ll gain hands-on experience in state-of-the-art labs and benefit from Aston’s strong industry connections. As a graduate of this programme, you’ll be ready to tackle global challenges in decarbonisation, renewable energy and sustainability. Whether you’re pursuing a career in industry or research, this programme will position you as a leader in the digital future of chemical engineering. More time. More experience. More impact. This course offers the opportunity to extend to 22 months through our Professional Practice route* . You’ll need to meet the criteria and secure a suitable placement. "An MSc in Digital Chemical Engineering is a future-proof investment for those passionate about using digital tools to advance chemical engineering and drive innovation. It meets industry demands, supports personal growth, and unlocks diverse career opportunities." Dr Amirpiran Amiri MSc Digital Chemical Engineering Programme Director Why Digital Chemical Engineering at Aston University? Digital-first focus One of the UK’s first programmes specialising in digital chemical engineering Industry-driven learning Designed to meet evolving industry needs in sustainability and digitalisation Advanced facilities Access cutting-edge labs, simulators and specialist software like MATLAB and Aspen Plus. 3rd in the UK Ranked 3rd overall in the UK for Chemical Engineering (Guardian, 2025) Top 5% in the world Top 5% of global evaluated institutions (QS World University Rankings 2026) Professional experience Opportunity to extend your studies and gain real-world experience through our professional practice route. Previous Next Engineering the digital future Discover how Aston University equips you with cutting-edge digital skills to solve real-world chemical engineering challenges. We're serious about employability As a postgraduate student, you will have access to dedicated careers guidance with specialist support from our experienced team of careers consultants Gain a competitive edge As well as opening doors, an Aston University postgraduate degree builds on your experience, develops your skills and gives you a competitive edge in a crowded job market Previous Next Course description MSc Digital Chemical Engineering Our MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme equips you with cutting-edge digital skills and knowledge to revolutionise chemical engineering processes sustainably. What we will provide We provide top-tier teaching in a vibrant, research-driven environment, supported by expert staff in digital chemical engineering. You’ll have access to cutting-edge labs and simulation tools, engaging in hands-on projects that apply digital techniques to real-world challenges, preparing you for a future in sustainable and innovative engineering. What you will provide You should have a reflective nature and resilience, as in chemical engineering, every experiment, calculation, failure and success is a lesson. You should be constantly analysing and improving your approach. It’s all about learning from experiences and using that insight to boost your professional development. You should be self-motivated, enjoy problem-solving challenges and be engaged in practical work. What skills we teach You will develop expertise in data-driven decision making, digital tools and techniques, machine learning, systems modelling and sustainable engineering. You will learn to design, simulate and optimise chemical processes while gaining practical skills in research, teamwork, project management and communication in both technical and non-technical settings. Professional practice year If you meet satisfactory academic performance and have secured a suitable professional experience, you will have the option to be transferred onto our MSc Digital Chemical Engineering including Professional Practice programme. Taking the professional practice route allows you to extend the duration of your masters to 22 months and gain valuable working experience to support your career aspirations. The placement commences after the completion of your MSc dissertation and can be paid work, study abroad exchanges or unpaid research projects or even a mix of these options. You will return to Aston the following May for an intensive period on campus to draw all your learning together and finalise the assessments. Career prospects Graduates can pursue careers in digital engineering, process optimisation, data analysis, sustainability and renewable energy. Roles include process engineer, data scientist, sustainability consultant and R&D engineer in industries such as energy, manufacturing and technology. Some may continue their studies with PhD opportunities or industry-focused research. How you will learn You will learn through a blend of lectures, seminars, workshops and hands-on practical lab sessions. These will equip you with both theoretical knowledge and real-world skills, using industry-relevant software and tools. You will engage in collaborative projects and problem-solving exercises, building your teamwork, critical thinking and adaptability. You will benefit from guest lectures by industry experts, giving you direct insights into current challenges and opportunities. You will also have the chance to attend industry events, where you can network with professionals and explore potential career paths. As part of your learning experience, you will complete a research project, applying your knowledge to practical, sustainable solutions. Extra-curricular opportunities, such as the Design Factory and student societies, will further enhance your university experience, connecting you with like-minded peers and industry professionals. Your personal tutor will offer guidance throughout, helping you develop both academically and professionally. Gain the advantage Our flagship professional development module provides a range of opportunities to apply your learning and increase your employability. Aston Global Advantage What you will learn The MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme offers a unique blend of chemical engineering principles with advanced digital technologies. You will study core topics such as digital process engineering, applied machine learning, smart sensors, and sustainable chemical and biochemical engineering design, equipping you with the skills to lead the transformation of industries toward greater sustainability. In the taught stage, you will engage with modules such as Engineering Project Management, Life Cycle Analysis and Circular Economy, and the Interdisciplinary Design Project. These modules will give you the opportunity to explore how digital tools, machine learning and smart technologies can optimise chemical processes and contribute to more sustainable engineering practices. You will develop both technical expertise and practical problem-solving skills in interdisciplinary environments, preparing you for the complex challenges of modern chemical engineering. In the dissertation phase, you will conduct a research project that applies these digital technologies to solve real-world engineering challenges. You will demonstrate your ability to independently analyse problems, design innovative solutions and contribute to advancing the field of digital chemical engineering. Course objectives Equips you with highly specialised core chemical engineering knowledge, skills and techniques necessary for critical thinking, digital design and cutting-edge research and development. Trains you to analyse and learn from data, make data-driven decisions, develop simulators and digital twins, and make sound judgements to improve the economy and sustainability of chemical processes. Develops you into a self-directed engineer capable of autonomously creating and managing innovative, digital-led, research-driven solutions for complex technical and social problems to advance sustainable development. Provides you with a deep understanding of societal and environmental issues, how research advances knowledge boundaries, and how to professionally plan, implement and communicate your findings to both specialist and non-specialist audiences. Equips you with the skills to continuously advance your knowledge and understanding, developing the ability to address evolving complex issues within the chemical engineering profession creatively and systematically. Modules Modules and learning outcomes Taught stage Dissertation stage Learning outcomes Taught stage modules In the taught stage you will study the following core modules: Module title Credits Aston Global Advantage 15 Engineering Project Management 15 Life Cycle Analysis and Circular Economy 15 Interdisciplinary Design Project 15 Smart Sensors and Control Systems 15 Digital Process Engineering 15 Sustainable Chemical and Biochemical Engineering Design 15 Total 105 You will choose one of the following optional modules. Depending on your prior knowledge, you will select either the Python-based module (Applied Machine Learning) or the MATLAB-based module (Machine Learning): Module title Credits Applied Machine Learning 15 Machine Learning 15 Read more » Dissertation stage modules In the dissertation stage you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Dissertation 60 Read more » Programme outcomes On successful completion of both the taught and dissertation stage, you will be able to: Design and evaluate new sustainable systems, processes, or products by thoroughly understanding the principles and technologies of sustainable chemical and biochemical engineering and applying these principles and technologies. Propose and/or invent state-of-the-art computational and analytical techniques to offer data-driven, effective solutions to complex challenges, using engineering judgment to work with information that may be uncertain or incomplete. Formulate complex problems and offer solutions both systematically and creatively, making sound judgements in the absence of complete data and reaching substantiated conclusions. Plan, implement, and self-direct a research project to develop new professional and communication skills, practice self-evaluation and independent working, and organise and record self-learning through project work packages. Plan and manage teamwork, practising peer evaluation, real-life leadership, and communication with diverse audiences. Design and validate an integrated system or approach to solve comprehensively defined problems that address a combination of societal, user, business, and customer needs, as appropriate. Evaluate the environmental and societal impact of solutions to multifaceted problems and reduce undesirable impacts. This will involve consideration of the entire life cycle, health and safety, diversity, inclusion, commercial matters, codes of practice, and industry standards, as well as the application of principles of circular economy and systems thinking. Read more » We may update our courses to reflect best practices and academic developments. If we do, we’ll let you know of any changes at the earliest opportunity by updating our course webpages. If you have already received an offer, we’ll write to you directly to let you know of the changes. Facilities In the MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme, you will benefit from access to cutting-edge laboratories and state-of-the-art simulation software. Our process and computer labs are equipped with advanced tools for digital process engineering, machine learning, and smart sensor applications. You will also have the opportunity to work with pilot-scale equipment, gaining hands-on experience with technologies used in industry to optimise and control chemical processes. Explore our facilities Entry requirements One of the following: 2:2 (lower second-class honours) degree or equivalent in chemical engineering Equivalent overseas degree recognised by Aston University (see international students tab below for more information) Additional requirements International students Extensive work experience You will also need to provide: A professional reference If you are a current student or recent graduate (within the last 2-3 years), we will ask for an academic reference If you are currently employed and not a recent graduate, we will ask for a professional reference An official academic transcript of your university grades to date A completed application form. Read more » Aston University is a diverse, close community and welcomes international students on many of our postgraduate programmes. Students from over 120 countries choose to study with us every year. Based in the centre of Birmingham, Aston is not only a great place to study but also a great place to live. Qualifications in your country For details of equivalent qualifications in your country, use our area pages below: Africa Americas Australia North East Asia Europe Middle East and North Africa South Asia South East Asia Western and Central Asia English language requirements Applicants whose first language is not English will be required to provide evidence of an English language qualification. English language requirements How to apply Aston University provides a range of opportunities for international students to join our community and study on our campus. A key part of our strategy is our relationships with teaching partners, providing multiple pathways to Aston. Aston’s professional work placements can improve your chance of securing a graduate job. Placements give you experience, confidence and opportunities and, as an Aston student, you’ll be better prepared for your future career. One of the great things about Aston is our focus on employability. Our close links with businesses, industries and professions make this possible. Find out more about applying Pathway programmes If you don’t meet our entry requirements, we have a range of pathway programmes offered by our partner, ONCAMPUS Aston, which you can complete to progress onto one of our degrees. Read more » We recognise the value of extensive professional experience. If you do not have the academic qualifications but have extensive and relevant professional experience and a proven ability to succeed, we would welcome your application. The information contained on this website details the typical entry requirements for this course for the most commonly offered qualifications. Applicants with alternative qualifications may wish to enquire with the relevant admissions teams prior to application whether or not their qualifications are deemed acceptable. For less commonly encountered qualifications this will be judged on a case-by-case basis in consultation with the academic admissions tutor. Read more » Speak to our Admissions Team If you have any questions about the application process please get in touch with our postgraduate admissions team: Email: pgadmissions@aston.ac.uk Call: 0121 204 3200 (Please note this line is open Monday-Friday between 09.30am-4.30pm) Read our guide to applying Fees and scholarships Course fees UK students (2027/28) Annual tuition fees: £11,850 International students (2027/278 Annual tuition fees: £24,800 More information on fees The United Kingdom government has confirmed that European Union (EU), other European Economic Area (EEA) and Swiss nationals commencing academic courses in England from August 2021 will no longer be charged the same tuition rates as UK students. Tuition fees for students are reviewed annually and may increase in subsequent years in line with inflation linked to the Retail Price Index (RPI) to take account of the University’s increased costs of delivering the Programme. Any such increase shall always be in accordance with the law. When undertaking a placement year, a placement year fee applies. More information on fees Scholarships At Aston University we are committed to supporting the most talented and hardworking students to achieve their potential by providing a range of scholarships to help lower tuition and living costs. Explore scholarships for UK students Explore scholarships for international students Assessment You will be assessed through a combination of written and oral examinations, class tests, individual and group coursework, projects, presentations, and practical assessments. Career prospects The MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme prepares graduates for a wide range of career opportunities in digital and sustainable chemical engineering. With expertise in areas like data-driven decision making, process design and digital tools, you will be well-equipped for roles in sectors such as: Process design engineer Data analyst Sustainability consultant Research and development engineer Machine learning engineer Digital twin specialist Graduates of this programme will be positioned to work in industries like chemical, energy, technology and manufacturing, contributing to innovations in digital engineering and sustainability. This programme also provides the foundation for those wishing to pursue further academic research or PhD opportunities, focusing on advancing digital applications in chemical engineering. Be part of our community Once you have joined us at Aston University, you’ll always be part of our community, even beyond graduation. Alumni services Frequently asked questions Why study Digital Chemical Engineering at Aston University? Aston University offers an academically rigorous and practically relevant MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme. Our curriculum equips you with the skills required for digitalisation and sustainability in chemical engineering, focusing on cutting-edge technologies such as data-driven decision-making, machine learning and sustainable process design. Ranked among the top for its commitment to sustainability and innovation, Aston University integrates advanced digital tools and a focus on real-world applications into your learning experience. With a strong emphasis on interdisciplinary collaboration and industry connections, our graduates are prepared to address global challenges, from decarbonisation to resource efficiency. We’re proud to have been named University of the Year for Student Success by the Daily Mail (2025), ensuring that our students are well-prepared for successful careers. Aston’s commitment to social mobility, alongside our extensive network of industry partners, provides students with the resources and opportunities to thrive in their professional journeys. Is Birmingham a good place to study? Our campus is based in the centre of Birmingham, the youngest major city in Europe and a great place to live, work and study. Great music and entertainment with a vibrant nightlife. Bars, clubs, pubs, live music, festivals, concerts. Whatever your tastes, there's something here for everyone. Fantastic food. Birmingham's diverse community means you can try anything from the famous Balti triangle, the Chinese Quarter, high street chains, halal and vegan food, and Michelin-star dining. World-class shopping. The Bullring and Grand Central is a shopper's paradise. From the world's biggest Primark to luxury brands at the Mailbox. Arts and culture. Museums, galleries, theatres, concerts and Birmingham's art collection is as wide as it is impressive - not to be missed. Green, open spaces. One of the greenest cities in Europe, Birmingham has hundreds of publicly accessible parks and green spaces across the city. Sporting action. Birmingham has some of the most exciting venues for watching or participating in sport in the UK. Discover Birmingham What is the Postgraduate Guaranteed Internship Scheme? Aston’s Postgraduate Guaranteed Internship Scheme means you get more than a degree; you will graduate with an industry internship and the experience and skills employers around the world are looking for. We guarantee an internship to all full-time students studying a taught master’s programme at either our Birmingham or London campus, including MA and MSc programmes, for students joining Aston in the 25/26 or 26/27 academic year. It is open to both international and UK students, and there is no charge to register or participate in the scheme. Our multi award-winning Careers and Placements Team will work with you to secure your industry internship which you will complete part-time, taking no more than 20 hours per week. The precise hours and timing will depend on each employer’s requirement, but will fit around your study timetable. The duration of the internship will usually be around two months, but could range from around one month up to six months. Postgraduate Guaranteed Internship Scheme Hello, what would you like to ask us? Hello! We are a team of current Aston University students from various parts of the world, studying a wide range of postgraduate subjects. Feel free to ask us anything about studying at Aston University. This will involve consideration of the entire life cycle, health and safety, diversity, inclusion, commercial matters, codes of practice, and industry standards, as well as the application of principles of circular economy and systems thinking. Read more » We may update our courses to reflect best practices and academic developments. If we do, we’ll let you know of any changes at the earliest opportunity by updating our course webpages. If you have already received an offer, we’ll write to you directly to let you know of the changes. Facilities In the MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme, you will benefit from access to cutting-edge laboratories and state-of-the-art simulation software. Our process and computer labs are equipped with advanced tools for digital process engineering, machine learning, and smart sensor applications. You will also have the opportunity to work with pilot-scale equipment, gaining hands-on experience with technologies used in industry to optimise and control chemical processes. Explore our facilities Entry requirements One of the following: 2:2 (lower second-class honours) degree or equivalent in chemical engineering Equivalent overseas degree recognised by Aston University (see international students tab below for more information) Additional requirements International students Extensive work experience You will also need to provide: A professional reference If you are a current student or recent graduate (within the last 2-3 years), we will ask for an academic reference If you are currently employed and not a recent graduate, we will ask for a professional reference An official academic transcript of your university grades to date A completed application form. Read more » Aston University is a diverse, close community and welcomes international students on many of our postgraduate programmes. Students from over 120 countries choose to study with us every year. Based in the centre of Birmingham, Aston is not only a great place to study but also a great place to live. Qualifications in your country For details of equivalent qualifications in your country, use our area pages below: Africa Americas Australia North East Asia Europe Middle East and North Africa South Asia South East Asia Western and Central Asia English language requirements Applicants whose first language is not English will be required to provide evidence of an English language qualification. English language requirements How to apply Aston University provides a range of opportunities for international students to join our community and study on our campus. A key part of our strategy is our relationships with teaching partners, providing multiple pathways to Aston. Aston’s professional work placements can improve your chance of securing a graduate job. Placements give you experience, confidence and opportunities and, as an Aston student, you’ll be better prepared for your future career. One of the great things about Aston is our focus on employability. Our close links with businesses, industries and professions make this possible. Find out more about applying Pathway programmes If you don’t meet our entry requirements, we have a range of pathway programmes offered by our partner, ONCAMPUS Aston, which you can complete to progress onto one of our degrees. Read more » We recognise the value of extensive professional experience. If you do not have the academic qualifications but have extensive and relevant professional experience and a proven ability to succeed, we would welcome your application. The information contained on this website details the typical entry requirements for this course for the most commonly offered qualifications. Applicants with alternative qualifications may wish to enquire with the relevant admissions teams prior to application whether or not their qualifications are deemed acceptable. For less commonly encountered qualifications this will be judged on a case-by-case basis in consultation with the academic admissions tutor. Read more » Speak to our Admissions Team If you have any questions about the application process please get in touch with our postgraduate admissions team: Email: pgadmissions@aston.ac.uk Call: 0121 204 3200 (Please note this line is open Monday-Friday between 09.30am-4.30pm) Read our guide to applying Fees and scholarships Course fees UK students (2027/28) Annual tuition fees: £11,850 International students (2027/278 Annual tuition fees: £24,800 More information on fees The United Kingdom government has confirmed that European Union (EU), other European Economic Area (EEA) and Swiss nationals commencing academic courses in England from August 2021 will no longer be charged the same tuition rates as UK students. Tuition fees for students are reviewed annually and may increase in subsequent years in line with inflation linked to the Retail Price Index (RPI) to take account of the University’s increased costs of delivering the Programme. Any such increase shall always be in accordance with the law. When undertaking a placement year, a placement year fee applies. More information on fees Scholarships At Aston University we are committed to supporting the most talented and hardworking students to achieve their potential by providing a range of scholarships to help lower tuition and living costs. Explore scholarships for UK students Explore scholarships for international students Assessment You will be assessed through a combination of written and oral examinations, class tests, individual and group coursework, projects, presentations, and practical assessments. Career prospects The MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme prepares graduates for a wide range of career opportunities in digital and sustainable chemical engineering. With expertise in areas like data-driven decision making, process design and digital tools, you will be well-equipped for roles in sectors such as: Process design engineer Data analyst Sustainability consultant Research and development engineer Machine learning engineer Digital twin specialist Graduates of this programme will be positioned to work in industries like chemical, energy, technology and manufacturing, contributing to innovations in digital engineering and sustainability. This programme also provides the foundation for those wishing to pursue further academic research or PhD opportunities, focusing on advancing digital applications in chemical engineering. Be part of our community Once you have joined us at Aston University, you’ll always be part of our community, even beyond graduation. Alumni services Frequently asked questions Why study Digital Chemical Engineering at Aston University? Aston University offers an academically rigorous and practically relevant MSc Digital Chemical Engineering programme. Our curriculum equips you with the skills required for digitalisation and sustainability in chemical engineering, focusing on cutting-edge technologies such as data-driven decision-making, machine learning and sustainable process design. Ranked among the top for its commitment to sustainability and innovation, Aston University integrates advanced digital tools and a focus on real-world applications into your learning experience. With a strong emphasis on interdisciplinary collaboration and industry connections, our graduates are prepared to address global challenges, from decarbonisation to resource efficiency. We’re proud to have been named University of the Year for Student Success by the Daily Mail (2025), ensuring that our students are well-prepared for successful careers. Aston’s commitment to social mobility, alongside our extensive network of industry partners, provides students with the resources and opportunities to thrive in their professional journeys. Is Birmingham a good place to study? Our campus is based in the centre of Birmingham, the youngest major city in Europe and a great place to live, work and study. Great music and entertainment with a vibrant nightlife. Bars, clubs, pubs, live music, festivals, concerts. Whatever your tastes, there's something here for everyone. Fantastic food. Birmingham's diverse community means you can try anything from the famous Balti triangle, the Chinese Quarter, high street chains, halal and vegan food, and Michelin-star dining. World-class shopping. The Bullring and Grand Central is a shopper's paradise. From the world's biggest Primark to luxury brands at the Mailbox. Arts and culture. Museums, galleries, theatres, concerts and Birmingham's art collection is as wide as it is impressive - not to be missed. Green, open spaces. One of the greenest cities in Europe, Birmingham has hundreds of publicly accessible parks and green spaces across the city. Sporting action. Birmingham has some of the most exciting venues for watching or participating in sport in the UK. Discover Birmingham What is the Postgraduate Guaranteed Internship Scheme? Aston’s Postgraduate Guaranteed Internship Scheme means you get more than a degree; you will graduate with an industry internship and the experience and skills employers around the world are looking for. We guarantee an internship to all full-time students studying a taught master’s programme at either our Birmingham or London campus, including MA and MSc programmes, for students joining Aston in the 25/26 or 26/27 academic year. It is open to both international and UK students, and there is no charge to register or participate in the scheme. Our multi award-winning Careers and Placements Team will work with you to secure your industry internship which you will complete part-time, taking no more than 20 hours per week. The precise hours and timing will depend on each employer’s requirement, but will fit around your study timetable. The duration of the internship will usually be around two months, but could range from around one month up to six months. Location: Aston University, Birmingham Apply now Register your interest Open Days Course type Full-time Entry requirements BBB (standard offer) BBC (contextual offer) Duration 4 years with integrated placement year (international students may opt out of the placement year) UCAS code(s) N590 Start date September 2027 Course overview Course description Course objectives Modules Entry requirements Fees and scholarships Career prospects Discover Uni Apply now Register your interest Open Days Course overview The BSc Digital Marketing programme at Aston University equips you with the knowledge and practical skills needed to thrive in a fast-paced world of digital marketing. Blending core marketing theory with industry standard digital tools, this programme will cover areas such as Content Marketing, User Experience, Social Media, Digital Analytics and Influencer Marketing. You will develop strong analytical, communication, and strategic decision-making skills, with a focus on innovation and ethical practice. The programme includes a compulsory placement year, offering valuable experience to enhance employability for a digital agency environment. With a balance of academic and practical application, this course prepares you to become an adaptable, forward-thinking marketer in a global digital economy. Whilst at university, you will have the opportunity to complete the CIM Certificate in Professional & Digital Marketing and will graduate with exemptions at Level 6. "Aston University is a great place to study. The placement year helps you to put knowledge into perspective, and then when you graduate you’ll know exactly what you’re doing. You will be a step ahead of everybody else, you have got that experience, you are ready, and you are rearing to go." Chloe Lansbury BSc (Hons) Marketing Senior Social Media Manager, Butterfly 3ffect Why Digital Marketing at Aston University? Top 25 in UK Marketing at Aston ranked in the UK's top 25 (Complete University Guide, 2027) Professionally accredited Throughout the programme the CIM Certificate in Professional & Digital Marketing will be embedded, with the option for you to achieve the professional qualification whilst studying Earn more Aston graduates are among the highest paid in the country, earning on average £40,300 five years after graduating (Longitudinal Education Outcomes, 2026) Gold standard teaching Aston University was awarded Gold - the highest possible rating for the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF, 2023) Global top 100 Aston University was ranked among the top 100 universities worldwide for marketing (QS World University Rankings by Subject, 2026) Top 5% in the world Top 5% of global evaluated institutions (QS World University Rankings 2027) Previous Next Chloe's story Chloe shares her experiences of studying Marketing at Aston University and how this helped her to secure her role as a Social Media Executive at Gymshark. Careers and Placements Whatever your Aston University journey, we're here to help. Discover what's possible with Careers and Placements. Previous Next Course description ASTON POWER SKILLS Built into every undergraduate degree Gain the skills employers look for worldwide. AI & Digital Innovation & Entrepreneurship Inclusive Leadership Environmental Sustainability Discover Power Skills BSc (Hons) Digital Marketing Explore digital marketing through data, creativity, and strategy. Gain real-world experience, industry insights, and skills to thrive in today’s fast-evolving digital landscape. What we will provide First-class teaching in the UK’s second-largest city, delivered by a diverse array of staff who will inspire and excite you. Our programme will empower you with core concepts of marketing theory, equipping you with practical skills for real-world scenarios. You will collaborate on live marketing projects, with local companies and experts, making your learning experience more rewarding. We are also an Adobe Creative Campus meaning you will have access to top-notch software licenses, including Adobe and Solidworks, commonly used in industry. What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies – understanding that intelligence and success come from dedication, a willingness to learn and the ambition to drive change and create value for businesses. What skills we teach You will gain expertise in digital strategy, content creation, data analytics, communication, UX design, market research, and social media. You will develop critical thinking, creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities, alongside practical experience through placements and exposure to real-world marketing challenges. Placement year We all know that taking a placement year will boost your employability – it’s what makes Aston University graduates some of the most employable in the country. It’s for this reason that we encourage every student to take one. The placement year gives you the chance to put theory into practice, gain relevant work experience, and develop professional and transferable skills. The placement year is compulsory for BSc (Hons) Digital Marketing students. International students can request permission to opt out of the placement year, but we strongly recommend that it is completed where possible. Career prospects As an Aston University Digital Marketing graduate, you will be equipped for a range of different career options. Potential careers include Digital Agency, Digital Marketing, Digital Analytics, Content Creation and Influencer Management. How you will learn Our teaching approach is both modern and innovative. Alongside traditional lectures and training in the latest analytical tools, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience during your placement, enhancing your overall learning. At the beginning of your course, you'll be assigned a personal tutor for individual study guidance. Module tutors are readily available to answer questions, and all lectures are recorded for future reference. Our emphasis is on practical knowledge application, with guest lectures from prominent business leaders and mentoring programs offering unique insights. Our renowned Visiting Professors , top UK business figures, share their expertise and expectations from students and graduates. Complementing traditional teaching, our virtual learning environment provides electronic support materials. You'll have access to the University Library's extensive collection of over 25,000 books and electronic journals. University-wide services like the careers service, Jobshop, counselling and advice services, sports facilities, and Chaplaincy enhance your overall university experience and prepare you for your professional career. Aston University also offers an array of extracurricular activities, including clubs and societies like Aston Bright Futures, which works with leading businesses across various sectors. These activities not only enrich your student experience but also help you explore your specific interests and career pathways. What you will learn This degree will equip you with problem solving skills that you can apply to various careers. Whether you’re interested in a career in in-house digital marketing, within social media strategy or as a digital analyst. First year You will gain a solid foundation in your first year across a breadth of marketing topics before shaping your second and final years to concentrate your study on your specialisms. Second year You will apply core theories of marketing to given scenarios, explore alternative solutions and provide recommendations. You will reflect and articulate your own learning and plan and implement strategies to build upon this. You will apply clear and original thinking in problem solving, demonstrating the ability to select and evaluate evidence and use the appropriate methods of analysis. Placement year The Aston University placement year forms an integral part of your educational journey and gives you the chance to put theory into practice, gain relevant work experience, and develop professional and transferable skills. Our award-winning careers and placements team are on hand to support you through every step of your placement journey. Placement stories Final year You will have more freedom and take ownership of your degree, having experienced both theoretical, applied and practical aspects of the subject, with more module choice to tailor your studies to your interests. Not only will you graduate with a great depth of knowledge, but you’ll also be equipped with independent, work-ready, commercial skills and relevant work experience. Course objectives Enables you to demonstrate understanding and application of core theory and knowledge in marketing within the wider business context. Enables you to work effectively as an independent self-managed/self-regulated learner who is socially responsible. Enables you to communicate effectively in a manner appropriate to the setting, task and/or audience. Develops innovative thinking in problem solving. Enables you to make appropriate operational and strategic decisions and to apply knowledge based on sound analysis in an international context. Modules Modules and learning outcomes Year 1 Year 2 Placement year Final year Year 1 modules In your first year you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Marketing Principles 15 Marketing Communications 15 Essential Skills for Marketers 15 Content Marketing 15 Law, Economics and Accounting for Marketers 15 Consumer Behaviour 15 Foundations of Business Analytics 15 Information Systems for Business 15 Total 120 Year 1 outcomes On successful completion of the first year, you will be able to: Explain and effectively use the fundamental concepts and theories of marketing and digital marketing. Evaluate and translate concepts and theories within that business subject area. Utilise different forms of communication in an individual or group setting. Demonstrate awareness of different approaches to solving problems related to your area of study. Apply communication and team working skills within your area of study. Demonstrate presentation skills within a marketing/business discipline. Demonstrate analytic skills relating to business and user experience. Read more » Year 2 modules In your second year you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Digital Marketing 15 Stakeholder Relations Management 15 Influencer Marketing 15 Agile Practices in IT and Management 15 Digital Analytics 15 Digital Organisations and the Future Work 15 Total 90 In term 1 you will choose one of the following optional modules:* Module Title Credits Market Research 15 User Experience Design 15 Enterprise Systems 15 Programming for Data Analytics 15 Business Analytics in Practice 15 In term 2 you will choose one of the following optional modules:* Module Title Credits Sports Marketing 15 Digital Strategies for the Modern Enterprise 15 Optimisation and Decision Analytics 15 Data Visualisation 15 *Availability of any optional modules will be subject to staff availability and a minimum number of students who express an interest in studying the optional modules. Year 2 outcomes On successful completion of the second year, you will be able to: Evaluate and apply the marketing theories and concepts from the varied marketing disciplines. Demonstrate competency in the analytics used in a digital marketing business contexts, and how to apply them. Analyse and integrate digital marketing concepts and theory to a specific construct or strategy. Evaluate and interpret qualitative and quantitative data with a view of constructing argument and making sound judgement within business disciplines. Provide innovative ideas/solutions to a problem or task. Read more » Placement year modules You will spend your third year on placement. You will be fully supported throughout the process by our award-winning Careers and Placements team. Placement year Module Title Credits Integrated Placement Year 120 Placement year outcomes On successful completion of the placement year, you will be able to: Analyse how marketing and or business principles operate within a company (work experience). Demonstrate the ability to work in a self-managed/self-directed way in an organisation. Demonstrate the ability to solve or provide solutions to a problem/issue within a company. Apply transferable skills and competencies within a real work-based situation (via placement experience). Identify and explore an organisational issue, using appropriate analytical tools, and recommend actionable improvements. Read more » Final year modules In your final year you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Technology and Practice of Ecommerce 15 Marketing Strategy 15 The Consulting Challenge 15 Digital Buyer Behaviour 15 Total 60 In term 1 you will choose two of the following optional modules:* Module Title Credits Ethical and Sustainable Marketing 15 Strategic Management and Innovation 15 Social Selling and Ecommerce 15 Performance and Efficiency Analytics 15 Strategic Sales Management 15 In term 2 you will choose two of the following optional modules:* Module Title Credits Digital Innovation for Marketing 15 Mastering Marketing Communications 15 Enterprise and Entrepreneurship for Marketing 15 Strategic Brand Management 15 Digital Analytics and AI 15 *Availability of any optional modules will be subject to staff availability and a minimum number of students who express an interest in studying the optional modules. Final year outcomes On successful completion of the final year, you will be able to: Demonstrate a systematic critical analysis and application of digital marketing concepts. Appreciate the implications of ethical practice within an organisational setting as an individual learner. Develop strategies based on a sound analysis and make decisions about how to implement them. Analyse specific digital innovations and technologies that impact upon the organisation, its core functions and audiences. Develop communication solutions that are relevant to marketing related practitioners. Demonstrate a systematic critical analysis and application of marketing concepts. Read more » We regularly review our modules to provide the best possible teaching and learning experience, incorporating academic developments, student feedback and employer feedback. There may be some change to some of the modules on this course for 2025/26 entry. We’ll make sure to let you know of any changes to modules at the earliest opportunity by updating our course webpages. We’ll do our best to provide as much optional choice as we can, but timetabling constraints may mean it isn’t possible to take some module combinations. The structure of some courses means that the order of modules or the streams you choose may determine whether modules are core or optional. This means that your core modules or options may differ from what’s shown here. ASTON POWER SKILLS Built into every undergraduate degree Gain the skills employers look for worldwide. Please note that we do not accept the English and Maths components within the Access qualification and you must meet the GCSE entry requirement. Year 2 entry: Please note that second year transfers are not part of the standard admissions process and is up to the discretion of the admissions team and tutor. Applications are only considered if there is space on that year of the programme. Typically, applicants for second year entry must meet the GCSEs and A Level (or equivalent) requirements as listed. Alongside this you must have successfully passed (or be expected to pass) your first year with 120 credits on an equivalent programme at another recognised university with very similar module content. The equivalency of the programme is reviewed by the Admissions Tutor and you will be required to provide an official copy of the programme specification of this. In order to be considered you will need to submit a UCAS application as we do not accept direct applications and this must include an academic reference. Year 3 entry onwards: We will not be able to consider any application for Year 3 or final year. Read more » International students Aston University is a diverse, close community and welcomes international students on many of our undergraduate programmes. Students from over 120 countries choose to study with us every year. Based in the centre of Birmingham, Aston is not only a great place to study, it’s also a great place to live. Qualifications in your country Applicants whose first language is not English will be required to provide evidence of an English language qualification. English language requirements International students can enter at Year 2 of this course having completed an undergraduate year one programme at the required academic level with approved teaching partners ONCAMPUS Aston or NCUK. Aston University provides a range of opportunities for international students to join our community and study on our campus. A key part of our strategy is our relationships with teaching partners, providing multiple pathways to Aston. Aston’s professional work placements can improve your chance of securing a graduate job. Placements give you experience, confidence and opportunities and, as an Aston student, you’ll be better prepared for your future career. One of the great things about Aston is our focus on employability. Our close links with businesses, industries and professions make this possible. Find out more about applying Fees and scholarships Course fees UK students (2027/28) First year tuition fee: £10,050* During placement year: £1,250* International students (2027/28) First year tuition fee: £23,500** During placement year: £2,500** * UK students (Home Undergraduate): Subject to parliamentary approval, the first year tuition fee will be £10,050, increasing annually in line with inflation for subsequent academic years. On 20 October 2025, the Government announced that tuition fees in England will be increased annually in line with inflation, starting in 2026. The Government have since confirmed that it intends to determine the inflation-linked increase using the Retail Price Index, although this is subject to parliamentary approval. According to the Department for Education’s Policy Paper published on 26 November, the annual tuition fee for the Programme commencing in the academic year 2027/28 is expected to be £10,050, subject to parliamentary approval. If you are holding an offer at Aston, when the annual tuition fee for your Programme for the 2027/28 academic year has been confirmed, we will write to update you. Our graduates are among the highest paid in the country, earning on average £33,200 three years after graduating, and £42,000 five years after graduating (Longitudinal Education Outcomes, 2025). Studying Digital Marketing opens up a wide range of exciting and fast-growing career opportunities across industries. This course equips you with the skills needed to thrive in today’s digital-first landscape, covering key areas such as Digital Agency operations, Digital Marketing strategy, Digital Analytics, Content Creation, and Influencer Management. Digital marketing is at the heart of how businesses connect with customers in today’s digital age. Studying digital marketing gives you more than just technical skills - it gives you a deep, strategic understanding of how brands grow, how data drives decision-making, and how to navigate the fast-changing world of digital platforms. The programme will set you up for long-term career growth, graduating with practical experience and industry connections. Whether you want to work in a creative agency, launch your own brand, or specialise in areas such as analytics or social media, this programme provides both the skills and experience to stand out in a competitive job market. How will a placement year benefit me? Whether you choose to study abroad or do a work placement, Aston University’s links with employers and universities around the world mean you will have a wide range of options to boost your employability and explore the world of work. Our work placements give you the opportunity to apply what you have learnt on your course while gaining valuable professional and paid experience. One of the greenest cities in Europe, Birmingham has hundreds of publicly accessible parks and green spaces across the city. Sporting action. Blending core marketing theory with industry standard digital tools, this programme will cover areas such as Content Marketing, User Experience, Social Media, Digital Analytics and Influencer Marketing. You will develop strong analytical, communication, and strategic decision-making skills, with a focus on innovation and ethical practice. The programme includes a compulsory placement year, offering valuable experience to enhance employability for a digital agency environment. With a balance of academic and practical application, this course prepares you to become an adaptable, forward-thinking marketer in a global digital economy. Whilst at university, you will have the opportunity to complete the CIM Certificate in Professional & Digital Marketing and will graduate with exemptions at Level 6. "Aston University is a great place to study. The placement year helps you to put knowledge into perspective, and then when you graduate you’ll know exactly what you’re doing. You will be a step ahead of everybody else, you have got that experience, you are ready, and you are rearing to go." Chloe Lansbury BSc (Hons) Marketing Senior Social Media Manager, Butterfly 3ffect Why Digital Marketing at Aston University? AI & Digital Innovation & Entrepreneurship Inclusive Leadership Environmental Sustainability Discover Power Skills BSc (Hons) Digital Marketing Explore digital marketing through data, creativity, and strategy. Gain real-world experience, industry insights, and skills to thrive in today’s fast-evolving digital landscape. What we will provide First-class teaching in the UK’s second-largest city, delivered by a diverse array of staff who will inspire and excite you. Our programme will empower you with core concepts of marketing theory, equipping you with practical skills for real-world scenarios. You will collaborate on live marketing projects, with local companies and experts, making your learning experience more rewarding. We are also an Adobe Creative Campus meaning you will have access to top-notch software licenses, including Adobe and Solidworks, commonly used in industry. What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies – understanding that intelligence and success come from dedication, a willingness to learn and the ambition to drive change and create value for businesses. What skills we teach You will gain expertise in digital strategy, content creation, data analytics, communication, UX design, market research, and social media. You will develop critical thinking, creativity, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities, alongside practical experience through placements and exposure to real-world marketing challenges. Placement year We all know that taking a placement year will boost your employability – it’s what makes Aston University graduates some of the most employable in the country. It’s for this reason that we encourage every student to take one. The placement year gives you the chance to put theory into practice, gain relevant work experience, and develop professional and transferable skills. The placement year is compulsory for BSc (Hons) Digital Marketing students. International students can request permission to opt out of the placement year, but we strongly recommend that it is completed where possible. Career prospects As an Aston University Digital Marketing graduate, you will be equipped for a range of different career options. Potential careers include Digital Agency, Digital Marketing, Digital Analytics, Content Creation and Influencer Management. How you will learn Our teaching approach is both modern and innovative. Alongside traditional lectures and training in the latest analytical tools, you'll gain valuable hands-on experience during your placement, enhancing your overall learning. At the beginning of your course, you'll be assigned a personal tutor for individual study guidance. Module tutors are readily available to answer questions, and all lectures are recorded for future reference. Our emphasis is on practical knowledge application, with guest lectures from prominent business leaders and mentoring programs offering unique insights. Our renowned Visiting Professors , top UK business figures, share their expertise and expectations from students and graduates. Complementing traditional teaching, our virtual learning environment provides electronic support materials. You'll have access to the University Library's extensive collection of over 25,000 books and electronic journals. University-wide services like the careers service, Jobshop, counselling and advice services, sports facilities, and Chaplaincy enhance your overall university experience and prepare you for your professional career. Aston University also offers an array of extracurricular activities, including clubs and societies like Aston Bright Futures, which works with leading businesses across various sectors. These activities not only enrich your student experience but also help you explore your specific interests and career pathways. What you will learn This degree will equip you with problem solving skills that you can apply to various careers. Whether you’re interested in a career in in-house digital marketing, within social media strategy or as a digital analyst. First year You will gain a solid foundation in your first year across a breadth of marketing topics before shaping your second and final years to concentrate your study on your specialisms. Second year You will apply core theories of marketing to given scenarios, explore alternative solutions and provide recommendations. You will reflect and articulate your own learning and plan and implement strategies to build upon this. You will apply clear and original thinking in problem solving, demonstrating the ability to select and evaluate evidence and use the appropriate methods of analysis. Placement year The Aston University placement year forms an integral part of your educational journey and gives you the chance to put theory into practice, gain relevant work experience, and develop professional and transferable skills. Our award-winning careers and placements team are on hand to support you through every step of your placement journey. Placement stories Final year You will have more freedom and take ownership of your degree, having experienced both theoretical, applied and practical aspects of the subject, with more module choice to tailor your studies to your interests. Not only will you graduate with a great depth of knowledge, but you’ll also be equipped with independent, work-ready, commercial skills and relevant work experience. Course objectives Enables you to demonstrate understanding and application of core theory and knowledge in marketing within the wider business context. Enables you to work effectively as an independent self-managed/self-regulated learner who is socially responsible. Enables you to communicate effectively in a manner appropriate to the setting, task and/or audience. Develops innovative thinking in problem solving. Enables you to make appropriate operational and strategic decisions and to apply knowledge based on sound analysis in an international context. Our graduates are among the highest paid in the country, earning on average £33,200 three years after graduating, and £42,000 five years after graduating (Longitudinal Education Outcomes, 2025). Studying Digital Marketing opens up a wide range of exciting and fast-growing career opportunities across industries. This course equips you with the skills needed to thrive in today’s digital-first landscape, covering key areas such as Digital Agency operations, Digital Marketing strategy, Digital Analytics, Content Creation, and Influencer Management. Dreaming big Ali-Reza Panjwani talks about his experience at Aston University and how it propelled him to becoming an executive director at J.P. Morgan in New York City. Discover Ali-Reza's journey Aston Business School graduates achieve some amazing things - whether it's setting up their own businesses, landing competitive graduate schemes, or making real differences within their communities. Hear from our graduates Be part of our community Once you have joined us at Aston University, you’ll always be part of our community, even beyond graduation. Alumni services Simba's journey beyond graduation After Aston, I went on The Apprentice Sunjay's journey beyond graduation After Aston, I worked with Kylie Minogue Christine's journey beyond graduation After Aston, I founded a global football franchise Previous Next Frequently asked questions Why study digital marketing? Digital marketing is at the heart of how businesses connect with customers in today’s digital age. Studying digital marketing gives you more than just technical skills - it gives you a deep, strategic understanding of how brands grow, how data drives decision-making, and how to navigate the fast-changing world of digital platforms. The programme will set you up for long-term career growth, graduating with practical experience and industry connections. Whether you want to work in a creative agency, launch your own brand, or specialise in areas such as analytics or social media, this programme provides both the skills and experience to stand out in a competitive job market. How will a placement year benefit me? Whether you choose to study abroad or do a work placement, Aston University’s links with employers and universities around the world mean you will have a wide range of options to boost your employability and explore the world of work. Our work placements give you the opportunity to apply what you have learnt on your course while gaining valuable professional and paid experience. It can enhance your graduate employment prospects and help you to make more informed career decisions. Around one in five of our placement students are offered graduate jobs by their placement employer. Find out more Is Birmingham a good place to study? Our campus is based in the centre of Birmingham, the youngest major city in Europe and a great place to live, work and study. Great music and entertainment with a vibrant nightlife. Bars, clubs, pubs, live music, festivals, concerts. Whatever your tastes, there's something here for everyone. Fantastic food. Birmingham's diverse community means you can try anything from the famous Balti triangle, the Chinese Quarter, high street chains, halal and vegan food, and Michelin-star dining. World-class shopping. The Bullring and Grand Central is a shopper's paradise. From the world's biggest Primark to luxury brands at the Mailbox. Arts and culture. Museums, galleries, theatres, concerts and Birmingham's art collection is as wide as it is impressive - not to be missed. Green, open spaces. One of the greenest cities in Europe, Birmingham has hundreds of publicly accessible parks and green spaces across the city. Sporting action. Birmingham has some of the most exciting venues for watching or participating in sport in the UK. At the end of your foundation year, you will also have the option to progress onto any of our undergraduate Aston Business School degrees . Please note you will still need to meet the GCSE requirements for the progression course. The foundation year will help build the confidence, academic skills and subject knowledge needed to succeed in your chosen degree programme. It provides a structured and supportive transition into degree-level study. To progress to BSc Economics and Finance , or an alternative Aston Business School programme if you change your mind, you simply need to achieve a 40% overall pass rate during your foundation year. Please note for BSc Accounting and Finance this is 50%. Why Economics and Finance Foundation at Aston University? AI & Digital Innovation & Entrepreneurship Inclusive Leadership Environmental Sustainability Discover Power Skills Course description Economics and Finance Foundation Programme Our Foundation Programme in Economics and Finance will equip you with a fundamental understanding of business at higher education level, preparing you for progression onto one of our undergraduate degree programmes. What we will provide First-class teaching in the UK’s second-largest city, delivered by a diverse array of staff who will inspire and excite you. You will receive subject-specific teaching, alongside development of your core academic skills, boosting your confidence and equipping you for the study years ahead. What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies – understanding that intelligence and success come from applying yourself. You must have drive and be willing to grow as an independent learner to take advantage of our resources and truly accelerate your potential. What skills we teach Through a range of teaching methods, you will develop and perfect core skills such as your critical thinking and teamwork. You will become a great communicator and learn how to present your ideas effectively. We will also ensure that you are fully equipped to study your chosen undergraduate course. How you will learn During your foundation year, you’ll have excellent support from your tutors and lecturers. We also have a dedicated Learning Services team who can provide additional support, in addition to a peer-assisted learning scheme. Group projects will give you the chance to meet new people, make new friends and build a network of people who will share your university journey. What you will learn The programme contains eight core modules which will prepare you for undergraduate study at Aston Business School. These modules include areas of marketing, business. accounting and finance, enterprise, economics, e-business, and academic and professional skills. Course objectives Provide students with knowledge and understanding of key concepts and debates in business, supporting progression to degree programmes across Aston Business School. Develop the essential study, research, and analytical skills needed to succeed in undergraduate business programmes at Aston University. Enhance transferable, professional, and communication skills that enable students to thrive both academically and within future career contexts. Modules Modules and learning outcomes The 12-month programme is made up of 120 credits which you will need to complete and pass before you can progress onto an undergraduate degree. Year 1 Year 1 modules In your first year you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Marketing, Consumer & Society 15 Academic and Professional Skills 15 Quantitive Methods for Business 15 Introduction to Business and Management 15 Accounting and Finance Fundamentals 15 E-Business 15 Enterprise, Innovation and Employability 15 Foundation to Economics 15 Total 120 Year 1 outcomes On successful completion of the first year, you will be able to: Discuss key concepts using appropriate terminology required for business. Use key concepts and theories in real life business contexts to find solutions to business problems. Solve well-defined practical problems using business concepts. Collect, interpret, and present data from a variety of sources. Reflect on learning needs to develop required competences in business. Collaborate in teams, using inclusive, effective communication and teamwork skills. Read more » We regularly review our modules to provide the best possible teaching and learning experience, incorporating academic developments, student feedback and employer feedback. We’ll make sure to let you know of any changes to modules at the earliest opportunity by updating our course webpages. We’ll do our best to provide as much optional choice as we can, but timetabling constraints may mean it isn’t possible to take some module combinations. The structure of some courses means that the order of modules or the streams you choose may determine whether modules are core or optional. This means that your core modules or options may differ from what’s shown here. ASTON POWER SKILLS Built into every undergraduate degree Gain the skills employers look for worldwide. It’s a mindset that will not just help you start your own business. But will enable you to thrive in any career. Every organisation values entrepreneurship. The curious, resourceful, those who seize the initiative. It’s why we’ve built Innovation & Entrepreneurship into every undergraduate degree. So, develop in-demand skills. Take control of your future. Get ready to think smart and reach the next level. Prepare for success whatever your goals.
