Any - True False Apply filters Clear all Home Courses Biosciences MRes Biosciences MRes Our Master of Research (MRes) in Biosciences is an exceptional programme designed for future researchers who wish to expand their knowledge of the complex field of biology. Location: Aston University, Birmingham Apply now Register your interest Course type Full-time Entry requirements UK 2:1 honours degree or international equivalent Duration One year Start date September 2027 Course overview Course description Facilities Course objectives Modules Entry requirements Fees Apply now Register your interest Course overview Advance your scientific career with the MRes Biosciences at Aston University, UK - a research-intensive master’s degree that prepares you for academic, clinical, or industrial careers in biological sciences. This programme offers a wide range of research specialisms, including: Cellular and molecular biology Ageing and age-related disease Immunology Biotechnology Stem cells and tissue engineering Microbiology This course equips you with both the theoretical foundation and practical laboratory skills needed for a career in scientific research. Whether your goal is to pursue a PhD, work in biotechnology, or contribute to a research-intensive organisation, you’ll gain the expertise to succeed. You’ll explore the core principles, recent developments, and emerging trends within your chosen field of specialisation, alongside a substantial independent research project, giving you the opportunity to: Deepen your understanding of cutting-edge scientific developments. Build advanced skills in laboratory research, data analysis, and critical thinking. Design and carry out experiments, and critically evaluate scientific literature. Please note: as part of your application to the MRes Biosciences programme at Aston University, you’ll need to choose an extended research project that aligns with your interests, a full list can be viewed below. Explore the full list of available research projects A biosciences-related degree is a mandatory entry requirement for this programme. Your application must also include a detailed research proposal to be considered. Please see our How to Apply section below If you’re unsure whether your qualifications meet our entry requirements, please contact out Postgraduate Admissions team. "Having undertaken my undergraduate degree in biology here, I knew Aston well, and I really liked the modules taught and that we get a lot of contact time with our lecturers. I then chose the MRes as I found I really enjoyed working in a laboratory setting where I could apply the knowledge I learned into my research." Jaspreet Bansal Biosciences MRes graduate, MIBTP PhD student Why Biosciences at Aston University? Internationally recognise research 100% of the Health and Life Sciences research environment has been ranked as being at least internationally excellent, with 50% being world-leading Research active staff Study alongside active researcher staff from a broad range of specialist biosciences areas. Independent research project Hands-on research experience via the completion of an extended dissertation project on a specific topic within biosciences. Previous Next Biosciences MRes at Aston University Ross Worledge shares his experience of the Biosciences MRes course at MSc at Aston University Course description Biosciences MRes Our Biosciences MRes at Aston will equip you with the skills, insights, and confidence required to become an outstanding bioscientist, well-equipped to advance research in the field. What we will provide First-class teaching in the UK's second-largest city, delivered by a diverse array of staff who will inspire and excite you,; fantastic facilities that will bring your course to life through hands-on, practical experience; and years of close industry collaboration that is harnessed to provide you with learning based on real-world needs. What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies - understanding that intelligence and success come from applying yourself. You must be able to demonstrate critical thinking and have ambition and drive to excel. What skills we teach From the start of the Biosciences MRes at Aston you will receive training in essential laboratory skills, and develop your research and communication skills. You will also study a series of 15 credit modules that will assist in the development of essential skills for planning, implementing and communicating research. Career prospects Our Biosciences MRes is valued by some of the best-known companies in the world. Recent graduates have successfully secured careers in a research-focused role in the industry, or undertaken further research in the form of a PhD at Aston or another leading university. How you will learn Our teaching is modern, practical, and research-led, bridging theory with real-world application. Throughout the course, you’ll apply your knowledge in laboratory and project settings, building the skills and confidence needed for a successful career in research or industry. Learning is delivered through a blend of: Lectures, seminars, and tutorials Laboratory work and practical sessions Online learning activities Independent study and guided reflection on feedback This mix of teaching methods supports both your academic development and your professional growth. What you will learn From the very start of the MRes Biosciences at Aston University, you will develop essential laboratory techniques alongside core skills in research design and scientific communication. The taught modules provide a solid foundation to prepare you for the 120-credit extended research project, which is the central focus of the programme and your year of study. Facilities State-of-the-art facilities for biosciences research As an MRes Biosciences student at Aston University, you’ll benefit from access to specialist laboratories and advanced equipment that reflect the hands-on nature of the course. Guided by academic experts, technicians, and industry professionals, you’ll gain practical experience in an environment designed to prepare you for real-world research. Our facilities include: Extensive laboratories - equipped with industry-standard technologies to support your learning and research. Advanced microscopy - including light, electron, confocal, and fluorescence microscopes for detailed cell, tissue, and organism analysis. Tissue culture facilities - with biosafety cabinets, CO₂ incubators, and sterile workspaces for advanced cell maintenance and experimentation. Bioreactor cell culture systems - enabling controlled growth of cells, microorganisms, and biomolecule production. Flow cytometry instruments - for analysing and sorting individual cells by size, shape, and fluorescence. These facilities ensure you gain the practical expertise and technical confidence needed for a successful career in bioscience research, healthcare, or industry. Aston University learning resources Refurbished lecture theatres, seminar rooms, and computer labs , providing an excellent environment for interactive learning and research. Virtual Learning Environment (VLE) - your hub for study, revision, and assessment, with access to a wide range of study materials, scientific journals, e-journals, and specialist databases. Aston University Library - a fully refurbished, digitally enabled space, open 24/7 at key times of the year. The library offers a variety of study spaces, access to academic support advisors, and an extensive collection of course texts in both print and electronic formats. These facilities ensure you have the tools, resources, and support needed to succeed in your studies and research. Biology for a Better Tomorrow Biology for a Better Tomorrow at Aston University highlights the vital role of biosciences in tackling sustainability challenges through stories of innovative research and real-world solutions. Find out more Course objectives Provide you with the opportunities to realise your academic potential through a range of learning experiences. Encourages you, through a practical approach, to have a passion for biosciences and an enthusiasm for learning. Provide you with the means to carry out an extensive laboratory-based project on a specific topic within the biosciences. Provide advanced theoretical and practical knowledge in a particular area within the field of biosciences research Provide training in biosciences laboratory skills. Provide awareness of good laboratory practise and safety issues in a modern research laboratory. Provide an opportunity to develop a range of transferable skills (written and oral communication, time management, project management, team working, data collection and analysis). Enable you to develop an informed and critical appreciation of the scientific developments within a particular area of biosciences research. Produce graduates with the necessary skills to proceed to a more specialist higher degree at PhD level or a career in biosciences research. Modules Modules and learning outcomes Taught stage Dissertation Stage Taught stage modules In the taught stage, you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Essential Laboratory Skills - Develop practical laboratory skills, including aseptic techniques, sample preparation, data collection, and analysis. Previous Next Biosciences MRes at Aston University Ross Worledge shares his experience of the Biosciences MRes course at MSc at Aston University Course description Biosciences MRes Our Biosciences MRes at Aston will equip you with the skills, insights, and confidence required to become an outstanding bioscientist, well-equipped to advance research in the field. What we will provide First-class teaching in the UK's second-largest city, delivered by a diverse array of staff who will inspire and excite you,; fantastic facilities that will bring your course to life through hands-on, practical experience; and years of close industry collaboration that is harnessed to provide you with learning based on real-world needs. What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies - understanding that intelligence and success come from applying yourself. You must be able to demonstrate critical thinking and have ambition and drive to excel. What skills we teach From the start of the Biosciences MRes at Aston you will receive training in essential laboratory skills, and develop your research and communication skills. You will also study a series of 15 credit modules that will assist in the development of essential skills for planning, implementing and communicating research. Career prospects Our Biosciences MRes is valued by some of the best-known companies in the world. Recent graduates have successfully secured careers in a research-focused role in the industry, or undertaken further research in the form of a PhD at Aston or another leading university. How you will learn Our teaching is modern, practical, and research-led, bridging theory with real-world application. Throughout the course, you’ll apply your knowledge in laboratory and project settings, building the skills and confidence needed for a successful career in research or industry. Learning is delivered through a blend of: Lectures, seminars, and tutorials Laboratory work and practical sessions Online learning activities Independent study and guided reflection on feedback This mix of teaching methods supports both your academic development and your professional growth. What you will learn From the very start of the MRes Biosciences at Aston University, you will develop essential laboratory techniques alongside core skills in research design and scientific communication. The taught modules provide a solid foundation to prepare you for the 120-credit extended research project, which is the central focus of the programme and your year of study. Facilities State-of-the-art facilities for biosciences research As an MRes Biosciences student at Aston University, you’ll benefit from access to specialist laboratories and advanced equipment that reflect the hands-on nature of the course. Guided by academic experts, technicians, and industry professionals, you’ll gain practical experience in an environment designed to prepare you for real-world research. Our facilities include: Extensive laboratories - equipped with industry-standard technologies to support your learning and research. Advanced microscopy - including light, electron, confocal, and fluorescence microscopes for detailed cell, tissue, and organism analysis. Tissue culture facilities - with biosafety cabinets, CO₂ incubators, and sterile workspaces for advanced cell maintenance and experimentation. Bioreactor cell culture systems - enabling controlled growth of cells, microorganisms, and biomolecule production. Flow cytometry instruments - for analysing and sorting individual cells by size, shape, and fluorescence. These facilities ensure you gain the practical expertise and technical confidence needed for a successful career in bioscience research, healthcare, or industry. Aston University learning resources Refurbished lecture theatres, seminar rooms, and computer labs , providing an excellent environment for interactive learning and research. Virtual Learning Environment (VLE) - your hub for study, revision, and assessment, with access to a wide range of study materials, scientific journals, e-journals, and specialist databases. Aston University Library - a fully refurbished, digitally enabled space, open 24/7 at key times of the year. The library offers a variety of study spaces, access to academic support advisors, and an extensive collection of course texts in both print and electronic formats. These facilities ensure you have the tools, resources, and support needed to succeed in your studies and research. This foundation year provides the essential academic knowledge, practical skills and confidence to succeed in university-level study. You’ll explore core principles in mathematics, physics and engineering science, while developing your problem-solving, teamwork and communication skills through collaborative, project-based learning. Working alongside students from other engineering disciplines, you’ll gain experience of interdisciplinary thinking and real-world ways of working. These are skills that are vital in the aerospace industry and beyond. You’ll also be part of a supportive learning community that helps you transition smoothly into degree-level study and prepares you to thrive in a fast-moving, high-tech sector. On successful completion, you’ll progress directly to our BEng (Hons) Aerospace Engineering degree. Why Aerospace Engineering Foundation Programme at Aston University? AI & Digital Innovation & Entrepreneurship Inclusive Leadership Environmental Sustainability Discover Power Skills Course description Aerospace Engineering Foundation Programme Aston University's Aerospace Engineering Foundation Programme will equip you with the essential skills and knowledge to progress onto our BEng (Hons) Aerospace Engineering degree. What we will provide You will benefit from expert teaching in the UK’s second largest city, delivered by passionate staff who are dedicated to your success. Our experienced faculty bring real-world insight into the classroom and will support you as you build the foundations for your future in aerospace engineering. You’ll have access to excellent facilities, including modern computer labs and industry-standard software. As an Adobe Creative Campus , we provide access to a wide range of professional tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud and Solidworks, widely used across the engineering sector. You are not required to bring your own device for this course. However, if you choose to do so, we recommend a laptop with an Intel i5 processor or above (or AMD equivalent). What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies – understanding that intelligence and success come from applying yourself, you must be able to demonstrate critical thinking and have ambition and drive to excel. What skills we teach You will build a strong foundation in key technical skills such as computer-aided design (CAD), model making using 3D printing and foam, and basic metal work. Alongside these, you will develop essential people skills including teamwork, communication, problem-solving and an understanding of ethical and social impact, preparing you for the diverse and evolving demands of aerospace engineering. Progression opportunities On successful completion of our Aerospace Engineering Foundation Programme, you will have the opportunity to progress onto our BEng (Hons) Aerospace Engineering degree. Graduates from Aston’s engineering programmes have gone on to roles such as design engineer, systems engineer and project manager with leading companies in the aerospace and engineering sectors. How you will learn Our teaching methods range from engaging lectures to interactive workshops, allowing you to absorb knowledge through multiple approaches. You will dive into real-world projects that challenge and inspire you through hands-on work, where you will put theory into practice. Here at Aston University, we are passionate about supporting our students. You will have a personal tutor throughout your studies to provide support and guidance. The Library and Learning Services is there to provide maths support, academic writing development, advice, and strategies for managing your studies. You will also have the opportunity to get involved in PAL sessions, learning from your peers who have been through the course content before you. What you will learn On this programme, you will be introduced to the core principles and disciplines of aerospace engineering, science and mathematics through a series of team-based projects. While developing the essential skills needed to progress onto BEng (Hons) Aerospace Engineering, you will gain valuable hands-on experience that will help you stand out in the industry. Facilities Aerospace engineering is a hands-on discipline combining lectures with practical lab work and design projects. You will develop individual and teamwork skills alongside peers, guided by experienced academics and expert technicians. Our engineering workshops and labs provide access to industry-standard equipment and spaces, including 3D printing and rapid prototyping facilities, laser cutting, CNC machining, and advanced CAD and simulation software. You will work in collaborative design studios equipped with the latest tools to support your projects. Dedicated project spaces and expert support help you bring your ideas from concept to reality. Alongside personal tutors and peer learning, our facilities ensure you gain valuable practical experience preparing you for the aerospace industry. Course objectives Provides you with the necessary fundamental skills and knowledge for progression into Stage 1 of study. Develops transferrable and communication skills required to be successful in further study. Develops ethical and inclusive, problem solvers and critical thinkers. Graduates will begin to develop the global awareness, sustainability and inclusive practice required in modern professional practice. Modules Modules and learning outcomes Modules Learning outcomes Foundation year modules In your foundation year you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Undergraduate Professional Skills 15 Mathematics 1 15 Introduction to Scientific Principles 15 Industries of the Future 15 Global Engineering Project 15 Engineering Science Foundations 15 Applied Physics Foundations 15 Mathematics 2 15 Total 120 Read more » Foundation year outcomes On successful completion of your foundation year, you will be able to: Use mathematical principles to solve well-defined problems. Solve well-defined problems using technical and scientific concepts relevant to the framework of study. Collaborate in multidisciplinary teams, demonstrating inclusive, effective communication and teamwork skills. Communicate discipline relevant technical ideas and solutions effectively, in a variety of ways, to diverse audiences, using appropriate terminology. Conduct practical activities using appropriate equipment/tools, review data and draw conclusions to support technical decision-making relevant to the framework of study. Discuss ethical and professional responsibilities, including stakeholder involvement, sustainability, safety, technical, EDI, and social factors. Collect, interpret, and present, data from a variety of sources. Reflect on their own learning needs and successes. Demonstrate awareness of project management principles and methods. Read more » We may update our courses to reflect best practices and academic developments. If we do, we’ll let you know of any changes at the earliest opportunity by updating our course webpages. If you have already received an offer, we’ll write to you directly to let you know of the changes. International students interested in a foundation programme should visit OnCampus Aston . UK students (2027/28) Annual tuition fees: £10,050* *UK students (Home Undergraduate): Subject to parliamentary approval, the first year tuition fee will be £10,050, increasing annually in line with inflation for subsequent academic years. On 20 October 2025, the Government announced that tuition fees in England will be increased annually in line with inflation, starting in 2026. The Government have since confirmed that it intends to determine the inflation-linked increase using the Retail Price Index, although this is subject to parliamentary approval. According to the Department for Education’s Policy Paper published on 26 November, the annual tuition fee for the Programme commencing in the academic year 2027/28 is expected to be £10,050, subject to parliamentary approval. If you are holding an offer at Aston, when the annual tuition fee for your Programme for the 2027/28 academic year has been confirmed, we will write to update you. We will also provide as much information as we can about the inflation-linked increase in tuition fees for future academic years. The duration of your programme is set out at the top of this webpage and you will be responsible for the payment of an annual tuition fee in each of these years. The University reserves the right to increase tuition fees annually in accordance with its terms and conditions and subject at all times to the maximum tuition fee caps set by Government from time to time. Please note that our current Terms and Conditions are for 2026 entry. We expect to publish our 2027 entry Terms and Conditions in summer 2026. This means that your total tuition fee may be higher than stated above. An increase in fees will allow the University to cover the increased costs of delivering the course and ensure it is able to maintain high standards of education and facilities. Scholarships At Aston University we are committed to supporting the most talented and hardworking students to achieve their potential by providing a range of scholarships to help lower tuition and living costs. Explore our scholarships Assessment This foundation programme employs a range of authentic assessment methods, including presentations, coursework, quizzes, and some exams. We make sure to coordinate deadlines to ensure you have a manageable workload. The assessment methods will reflect the most effective and relevant way to review your performance for each module. Therefore, each module will be assessed in a variety of ways to reflect your knowledge from that module and how you would apply it in the real world. Career prospects Foundation programmes at Aston are designed to prepare you for successful progression to your chosen undergraduate degree. By developing essential academic skills, subject knowledge and confidence in university‑level study, the foundation year gives you a strong platform for success throughout your bachelors degree and future career. After finishing their BEng or MEng degree, some graduates have secured roles such as mechanical engineer, design engineer, project manager and consultant with leading companies including BAE Systems, Bentley Motors, Network Rail, Caterpillar Inc, Corus and Jaguar Land Rover. Be part of our community Once you have joined us at Aston University, you’ll always be part of our community, even beyond graduation. Our Aerospace Engineering Foundation Programme is designed to build your confidence and technical skills, preparing you fully for progression onto your degree. You will learn through interactive teaching, hands-on experiments and collaborative projects that connect theory with real-world applications. At Aston, you benefit from a dedicated foundation team who specialise in personalised support and small-group teaching, helping you every step of the way. You’ll also have access to extensive university resources including one-to-one tutoring, workshops and peer-assisted learning sessions, all aimed at supporting your academic success. As an Aston student, you’ll join a vibrant community with access to the Students’ Union, student societies and wider campus facilities. This supportive environment, combined with practical learning and skill development, equips you to thrive in aerospace engineering and beyond. Is Birmingham a good place to study? Location: Online via distance learning Applications are now closed Course type Professional short courses/CPD Entry requirements See our entry requirements Duration Four months Start date October 2026 Module overview Entry requirements Fees Delivery and assessment Applications are now closed Module overview Please note the application deadline for this course is Monday 31 August 2026. Studied via distance learning, this standalone module offers a comprehensive exploration of the ageing eye, focusing on the latest developments in optometric research and clinical practice. Designed for optometrists and eye care practitioners, it provides an evidence-based approach to managing the unique challenges presented by an ageing population. The indicative content of the module includes the optometric examination of older patients, the aetiology and management of presbyopia and techniques for restoring near visual function. It also covers the assessment of geriatric low-vision patients, fitting and dispensing for older adults and the optometric management of conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, stroke and visual hallucinations. Additional topics include the identification of ocular signs of physical abuse and visual risk factors for falls in older patients. This is a level 7 module (equivalent level of study to a postgraduate or masters degree) worth 20 credits . Module tutor(s): Professor Leon Davies Why Ageing Eye Management at Aston University? Excellent prospects Ranked 2nd in the UK for ‘graduate prospects – on track’ (Optometry, Ophthalmics and Orthoptics; Complete University Guide, 2025) Specialist facilities Access cutting-edge equipment in our ophthalmic simulation suite Research active staff Learn from passionate research-active academics in specialist areas of optometry, ophthalmics and orthoptics Previous Next Objectives and outcomes Provides a comprehensive overview of recent and future developments in optometric research related to the ageing eye, ensuring you stay informed in a rapidly evolving field. Equips you with the knowledge to manage ageing patients effectively, covering topics such as optometric examination, low vision rehabilitation, dispensing for older patients, stroke management, presbyopia and visual risk factors for falls. Enhances your ability to integrate evidence-based practices through clinical case records, allowing you to reflect on your experiences and apply your learning to real-world scenarios. On successful completion of this module you will be able to: Demonstrate a comprehensive, research-based understanding of factors related to the ageing eye. Demonstrate a detailed understanding of the diagnosis and subsequent management of ageing patients in clinical optometric practice. Draw on research evidence to inform clinical practice. Demonstrate detailed knowledge of technology and techniques used to assess and support the visual function of ageing patients in clinical and research settings. Speak to our Admissions Team If you have any questions about the application process please get in touch with our postgraduate admissions team: Email: professionalcpd@aston.ac.uk Read our guide to applying Entry requirements You should be a registered optometrist with the UK General Optical Council (GOC) or another eye care professional. Fees UK students (2026/27) £715 per 10 credits (£1,430 for full module) More information on fees The United Kingdom government has confirmed that European Union (EU), other European Economic Area (EEA) and Swiss nationals commencing academic courses in England from August 2021 will no longer be charged the same tuition rates as UK students. Tuition fees for students are reviewed annually and may increase in subsequent years in line with inflation linked to the Retail Price Index (RPI) to take account of the University’s increased costs of delivering the Programme. Any such increase shall always be in accordance with the law. When undertaking a placement year, a placement year fee applies. More information on fees Delivery and assessment This course is delivered via distance learning. You will access learning materials for general study, revision and assessment via our virtual learning environment, Blackboard. This platform allows you to access a comprehensive range of study materials, scientific journals, e-journals, databases and much more. Method of delivery Learning hours Independent activity 150 hours Formative assessment activity 50 hours Total 200 hours Assessment The assessment for this standalone module comprises two components: Multiple choice questions (10%): An open-book, one-hour exam testing your understanding of lecture content. Case study (90%): Two case reports with reflections and references, or an essay assignment (title must be approved by the module lead). Hello, what would you like to ask us? Hello! They have been designed to allow you to develop specialist knowledge in advanced optometric topics. Clinical application and content may allow eye care professionals to widen and specialise their mode of practice. Use it to reshape how organisations operate and compete in a global market. Location: Aston University, Birmingham Apply now Register your interest Agent application Course type Full-time Entry requirements UK 2:2 honours degree or international equivalent Duration One year Start date September 2027 GUARANTEED INTERNSHIPS WITH EVERY MASTER'S DEGREE Course overview Course description What you will learn Course objectives Modules Entry requirements Fees and scholarships Career prospects Apply now Register your interest Agent application GUARANTEED INTERNSHIPS WITH EVERY MASTER'S DEGREE Find out more Course overview Artificial Intelligence has already impacted people's lives day-to-day, but it also has a wider impact on businesses and their operations. In the fast-evolving world, businesses need to embrace AI tools and be ready for an AI driven revolution. This course will allow you to understand an organisation’s business and digital transformation journey and critically evaluate the role of AI as an enabler of transformation. You will be exposed to AI and analytics focused tools, which together with essential leadership and change management capabilities, will equip you with the skills needed to lead organisation's business transformation processes. Capgemini are a leading advisor and transformation partner to companies around the world, leveraging technology to enable business transformation for almost 60 years. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work on Capgemini defined research projects. You will also have the opportunity to undertake an internship with the company with access to Capgemini facilities - gaining hands-on practical experience. Capgemini will contribute to the design and delivery of one of the course modules. This programme is co-developed with industry partners through Aston’s Centre of Excellence for Enterprise AI, ensuring you gain up-to-date, practical knowledge. You’ll also benefit from professional development sessions through the Aston Global Advantage, and have the opportunity to gain the ISACA Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals Certificate, validating your foundational expertise in AI. Why AI for Business Transformation at Aston University? Industry relevant Structured according to the People, Processes and Technology Management Framework, which is at the heart of organisation business transformation process Recognised for quality Aston Business School is proud to be among 1% of business schools worldwide with triple accreditation Top 5% in the world Top 5% of global evaluated institutions (QS World University Rankings 2027) Top 100 in Europe Aston Business School ranked 15th in the UK and 90th in Europe (Financial Times European Business Schools ranking 2025) Created with Capgemini Capgemini support through guest lectures, research projects and internship opportunities Previous Next AI for Business Transformation with Capgemini See how the partnership between Capgemini and Aston University is giving students access to real-world projects, industry expertise, and career opportunities that prepare them for the future of work. Centre of Excellence for Enterprise AI launch We combine Aston University’s strengths in AI innovation with Capgemini’s extensive experience as a transformation partner to help organisations develop and implement impactful AI solutions. Previous Next Course description AI for Business Transformation with Capgemini The MSc AI for Business Transformation with Capgemini is designed to equip you with cutting-edge knowledge of AI technologies to make you highly employable in today’s evolving job market. This programme blends technological insight with strategic business acumen, preparing graduates for dynamic roles driving digital transformation (DT) across industries. What we will provide First-class teaching in the UK’s second-largest city, delivered by a diverse array of staff who will inspire and excite you. You will benefit from applied learning, research-informed teaching and constructive assessment. There are practical activities, including simulation exercises, reflective case studies, collaborative group work, thought-provoking class discussions as well as inspiring lectures and tutorials. Through our partnership with Capgemini, you will receive guest lectures, have the opportunity to work on research projects and also complete hands-on internships guided and defined by Capgemini. The company will also contribute to the design and delivery of one of the course modules. We are also an Adobe Creative Campus meaning you will have access to top-notch software licenses, including Adobe and Solidworks, commonly used in industry. What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies – understanding that intelligence and success come from applying yourself, a willingness to learn and an ambition and drive to excel. What skills we teach Skills vary from those that relate to people, to others in processes and technology. You will acquire skills related to change management and leadership, project and process management, analytical thinking and problem solving, data analytics, business and IT alignment. The course is taught in partnership with Capgemini, meaning you will benefit from gaining skills from a global leader in AI and technology. Career prospects The World Economic Forum’s Future of Jobs report (2023) stated that AI and machine learning specialists together with data analytics and digital transformation specialists are the most prominent emerging roles. Graduates can pursue roles such as: Digital Transformation Consultant, Change Manager, AI Strategy Analyst, Technical Project Lead, Business Transformation Manager and Data-Driven Innovation Consultant. How you will learn The delivery will include large and small group activities, case studies and guest lectures from renowned practitioners in AI and Business/Digital Transformation, including from Capgemini. Our online learning platform supports your studies with all the necessary digital resources, including lecture slides, access to e-books and online journals, and video recordings of teaching sessions. Additionally, your lecturers will be available for one-to-one support to help you with any challenging topics. In the Aston Global Advantage module, you will gain a competitive edge by honing your professional skills and preparing for success in a fast-paced global environment. You will tackle real-world challenges, dive into entrepreneurship and work on team-based business simulations. At the start of your course, you will be allocated a personal tutor who can offer individual study advice and guidance. You will also benefit from access to the University Library's extensive collection of over 25,000 books and electronic journals. Gain the advantage Our flagship professional development module provides a range of opportunities to apply your learning and increase your employability. The Aston Global Advantage What you will learn You will gain an applied understanding of how generative AI and emerging technologies can shape business models, enhance performance, and support organisational culture change. Designed to address a market gap, this course offers a unique pathway for the future of AI in business. The programme covers essential leadership and change management skills, project and process management, data analytics, and problem-solving techniques. You will also develop expertise in evaluating AI technologies, designing evidence-based transformation strategies, and applying the People-Processes-Technology (PPT) management framework to real-world business challenges. Through case studies, industry insights, and hands-on projects, you will emerge equipped to lead AI-enabled transformation initiatives responsibly, ethically, and with measurable impact. Learn business, do business Our classroom goes beyond traditional lectures, focusing instead on real-life projects and hands-on experiences. Student experience Course objectives Develop competencies essential for the understanding of the use of AI in a broad range of business contexts Equip you with a systematic understanding of how AI tools can support business digital transformation journeys Develop skills that help you to apply the people – processes – technology (PPT) management framework to achieve digital transformation and readiness to organisational changes Ensure you understand the importance of responsible and ethical use of AI and other emerging technologies Provide you with the opportunity to enhance your employability skills by equipping you with key professional skills and competencies required for success in a global business context, thus contributing to several UN sustainable Development Goals (SDG). Modules Modules and programme outcomes Taught stage Dissertation stage Programme outcomes Taught stage modules In the taught stage you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Leadership for Transformational Change This module explores the dynamic interplay between leadership, change management, and organisational culture. It delves into the complexities of leading organisations through transformational change, emphasising the role of leadership in shaping, sustaining, and evolving organisational culture. The module provides theoretical insights, practical tools, and real-world case studies to equip you with the skills necessary to lead effectively in environments characterised by uncertainty, diversity, and constant change. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and experiential learning activities, you will develop a deep understanding of how to foster a resilient and adaptive organisational culture in the face of ongoing change. 15 Artificial Intelligence for Business Rapid progress of information technology advances in business have intensified. New technologies built on the web3 infrastructure deliver far more complex technologies in easy instantly accessible ways. The complexity and impact of such new technologies on business is profound. Artificial Intelligence is testimony to radical changes businesses are grappling with. We are at the cusp of switching from wondering what AI can do for business and how to implement effective redesign of businesses. Currently, a pragmatic relearning of the core elements representing technology as organisational structures, business models and the reach of technology within these primary spheres is transformed, along with people (employees and customers). Hence, this AI module will be a timely primer towards these objectives. 15 Predictive Analytics This module introduces students to essential concepts of data analysis, including data types, visualisation techniques, data preprocessing, and dashboard design. Students explore statistical learning methods from a high-level perspective while gaining hands-on experience with real-world datasets. Through practical exercises and projects, learners develop critical skills for analysing and interpreting data, making data-driven decisions, and designing compelling visualisations. The module emphasizes employability by equipping students with in-demand analytical skills and encourages enterprise thinking through creative problem-solving. By engaging in experiential learning, students apply theory to practice, preparing for careers in data-driven industries. This module is key to building a solid foundation in data science and enhancing students' ability to communicate insights effectively. 15 Digital and Business Transformation This module explores the transformative impact of digital technologies on business models, driving changes in products, services, and organisational structures while automating processes. The widespread adoption of technologies such as the Internet, social media, data analytics, collaborative tools, AI, and cloud computing has revolutionised industries by removing traditional boundaries of time and geography. These innovations have fostered virtual communities of employees, customers, and suppliers, introducing new market demands. Understanding the mechanics and scale of this change is central to digital transformation, enabling organisations to harness these technologies to improve productivity, reduce costs, and stimulate innovation. This comprises the core content of the module. 15 Responsible AI and the Governance of Emerging Technologies This module develops your ability to critically evaluate AI regulatory and governance frameworks and assess the ethical risks associated with emerging digital technologies. You will apply advanced ethical frameworks to analyse organisational challenges, appraise the consequences of algorithmic bias for responsible managerial decision‑making, and formulate evidence‑based recommendations for the ethical use of AI. Drawing on contemporary research and real‑world case studies, you will build the judgement required to guide responsible and accountable technology adoption within organisations. 15 Managing Projects Project management knowledge has improved substantially over the period through collaborative contributions from industries and academia. However, there are still incidents affecting time, cost and quality of projects all across the industries and geographical locations. This module will enable you to understand characteristics of projects, applications of project management tools and techniques. 15 Value Creation and Business Impact with AI This module equips you with the skills to identify, design, and evaluate high‑value AI opportunities in organisational settings. You will analyse business processes to uncover inefficiencies, prioritise AI use cases, and develop AI‑enhanced business model concepts that clearly articulate value creation, data needs, and workflow integration. You will build ROI and KPI models to support evidence‑based evaluation for senior stakeholders, considering costs, benefits, and risks. Throughout the module, industry insights - especially from Capgemini - guide the refinement of proposals to ensure strategic alignment, feasibility, and real‑world applicability, culminating in a live practitioner‑engaged challenge. 15 The Aston Global Advantage The Aston Global Advantage is our professional development programme that runs throughout all MSc programmes at Aston Business School. Focusing on professional development and employability, this integrated module gives you the opportunity to identify, develop and apply the key transferrable skills you will gain throughout the year. 15 Applied Research Methods and Skills 15 Read more » Dissertation stage modules In the dissertation stage you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Dissertation/Research project The research project offers a unique opportunity for you to take the initiative and dive deep into a specific topic, fostering personal and academic growth. Building on the foundational knowledge gained in the taught portion of the programme, this module sharpens essential analytical and academic skills for lifelong learning in today's dynamic business landscape. By conducting independent empirical or theoretical research, you gain a deeper understanding of their chosen subject and contribute to the field. Additionally, this module serves as a stepping stone for those considering further research degrees. There is also the possibility of working on a live project provided by Capgemini or other external organisations, under the joint supervision of an Aston University member of staff and a practitioner from the organisation. 45 Read more » Programme outcomes On successful completion of both the taught and dissertation stage, you will be able to: Critically evaluate AI technologies, data-driven methods, and digital transformation frameworks to determine appropriate AI-enabled solutions for complex business challenges. Critically analyse organisational culture, stakeholder dynamics, and human factors to formulate evidence-based strategies for people-centred digital transformation. Create AI-informed redesigns of business operations to produce measurable improvements in efficiency, decision quality, or service delivery. Work effectively in teams to communicate, manage and deliver projects professionally. Appraise ethical risks, governance requirements and societal implications linked to AI use within contemporary organisations. Demonstrate advanced capability to guide organisational change that supports successful business transformation. Create, interpret, and synthesise AI-generated and evidence-based insights to support senior decision-makers in strategic planning, operational improvement, and AI-enabled organisational transformation. Studying MSc AI for Business Transformation prepares you to lead AI-driven change where it matters most - within organisations. This industry-co-created programme, endorsed by Capgemini, uniquely approaches AI through a management and transformation lens rather than a purely technical one, aligning people, processes and technology to deliver real business impact. You will develop future-ready skills in leadership, change management, analytics and AI strategy, grounded in ethical and responsible AI practice. Through applied learning, industry engagement and the opportunity to work on live business projects, the course equips you to meet the growing global demand for professionals who can translate AI innovation into sustainable organisational value. The exact distribution of these hours will vary depending on your course and module choices. You will be exposed to AI and analytics focused tools, which together with essential leadership and change management capabilities, will equip you with the skills needed to lead organisation's business transformation processes. Capgemini are a leading advisor and transformation partner to companies around the world, leveraging technology to enable business transformation for almost 60 years. They address the entire breadth of business needs, from strategy and design to managing operations and engineering, drawing on deep industry knowledge and technical expertise in cloud, data, artificial intelligence, connectivity, software, digital engineering, and platforms.​ Industry-driven learning Capgemini will deliver guest lectures as part of the course, expanding your knowledge and experience of relevant topics. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to work on Capgemini defined research projects. You will also have the opportunity to undertake an internship with the company with access to Capgemini facilities - gaining hands-on practical experience. Capgemini will contribute to the design and delivery of one of the course modules. This programme is co-developed with industry partners through Aston’s Centre of Excellence for Enterprise AI, ensuring you gain up-to-date, practical knowledge. You’ll also benefit from professional development sessions through the Aston Global Advantage, and have the opportunity to gain the ISACA Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals Certificate, validating your foundational expertise in AI. Why AI for Business Transformation at Aston University? Industry relevant Structured according to the People, Processes and Technology Management Framework, which is at the heart of organisation business transformation process Recognised for quality Aston Business School is proud to be among 1% of business schools worldwide with triple accreditation Top 5% in the world Top 5% of global evaluated institutions (QS World University Rankings 2027) Top 100 in Europe Aston Business School ranked 15th in the UK and 90th in Europe (Financial Times European Business Schools ranking 2025) Created with Capgemini Capgemini support through guest lectures, research projects and internship opportunities Previous Next AI for Business Transformation with Capgemini See how the partnership between Capgemini and Aston University is giving students access to real-world projects, industry expertise, and career opportunities that prepare them for the future of work. Centre of Excellence for Enterprise AI launch We combine Aston University’s strengths in AI innovation with Capgemini’s extensive experience as a transformation partner to help organisations develop and implement impactful AI solutions. Previous Next Course description AI for Business Transformation with Capgemini The MSc AI for Business Transformation with Capgemini is designed to equip you with cutting-edge knowledge of AI technologies to make you highly employable in today’s evolving job market. This programme blends technological insight with strategic business acumen, preparing graduates for dynamic roles driving digital transformation (DT) across industries. What we will provide First-class teaching in the UK’s second-largest city, delivered by a diverse array of staff who will inspire and excite you. You will benefit from applied learning, research-informed teaching and constructive assessment. There are practical activities, including simulation exercises, reflective case studies, collaborative group work, thought-provoking class discussions as well as inspiring lectures and tutorials. Through our partnership with Capgemini, you will receive guest lectures, have the opportunity to work on research projects and also complete hands-on internships guided and defined by Capgemini. The company will also contribute to the design and delivery of one of the course modules. We are also an Adobe Creative Campus meaning you will have access to top-notch software licenses, including Adobe and Solidworks, commonly used in industry. What you will provide It is important you learn how to adapt a growth mindset to your studies – understanding that intelligence and success come from applying yourself, a willingness to learn and an ambition and drive to excel. What skills we teach Skills vary from those that relate to people, to others in processes and technology. You will acquire skills related to change management and leadership, project and process management, analytical thinking and problem solving, data analytics, business and IT alignment. The course is taught in partnership with Capgemini, meaning you will benefit from gaining skills from a global leader in AI and technology. Career prospects The World Economic Forum’s Future of Jobs report (2023) stated that AI and machine learning specialists together with data analytics and digital transformation specialists are the most prominent emerging roles. Graduates can pursue roles such as: Digital Transformation Consultant, Change Manager, AI Strategy Analyst, Technical Project Lead, Business Transformation Manager and Data-Driven Innovation Consultant. How you will learn The delivery will include large and small group activities, case studies and guest lectures from renowned practitioners in AI and Business/Digital Transformation, including from Capgemini. Our online learning platform supports your studies with all the necessary digital resources, including lecture slides, access to e-books and online journals, and video recordings of teaching sessions. Additionally, your lecturers will be available for one-to-one support to help you with any challenging topics. In the Aston Global Advantage module, you will gain a competitive edge by honing your professional skills and preparing for success in a fast-paced global environment. You will tackle real-world challenges, dive into entrepreneurship and work on team-based business simulations. At the start of your course, you will be allocated a personal tutor who can offer individual study advice and guidance. You will also benefit from access to the University Library's extensive collection of over 25,000 books and electronic journals. Gain the advantage Our flagship professional development module provides a range of opportunities to apply your learning and increase your employability. The Aston Global Advantage What you will learn You will gain an applied understanding of how generative AI and emerging technologies can shape business models, enhance performance, and support organisational culture change. Designed to address a market gap, this course offers a unique pathway for the future of AI in business. The programme covers essential leadership and change management skills, project and process management, data analytics, and problem-solving techniques. You will also develop expertise in evaluating AI technologies, designing evidence-based transformation strategies, and applying the People-Processes-Technology (PPT) management framework to real-world business challenges. Through case studies, industry insights, and hands-on projects, you will emerge equipped to lead AI-enabled transformation initiatives responsibly, ethically, and with measurable impact. Learn business, do business Our classroom goes beyond traditional lectures, focusing instead on real-life projects and hands-on experiences. Student experience Course objectives Develop competencies essential for the understanding of the use of AI in a broad range of business contexts Equip you with a systematic understanding of how AI tools can support business digital transformation journeys Develop skills that help you to apply the people – processes – technology (PPT) management framework to achieve digital transformation and readiness to organisational changes Ensure you understand the importance of responsible and ethical use of AI and other emerging technologies Provide you with the opportunity to enhance your employability skills by equipping you with key professional skills and competencies required for success in a global business context, thus contributing to several UN sustainable Development Goals (SDG). Modules Modules and programme outcomes Taught stage Dissertation stage Programme outcomes Taught stage modules In the taught stage you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Leadership for Transformational Change This module explores the dynamic interplay between leadership, change management, and organisational culture. It delves into the complexities of leading organisations through transformational change, emphasising the role of leadership in shaping, sustaining, and evolving organisational culture. The module provides theoretical insights, practical tools, and real-world case studies to equip you with the skills necessary to lead effectively in environments characterised by uncertainty, diversity, and constant change. Through a combination of lectures, discussions, and experiential learning activities, you will develop a deep understanding of how to foster a resilient and adaptive organisational culture in the face of ongoing change. 15 Artificial Intelligence for Business Rapid progress of information technology advances in business have intensified. New technologies built on the web3 infrastructure deliver far more complex technologies in easy instantly accessible ways. The complexity and impact of such new technologies on business is profound. Artificial Intelligence is testimony to radical changes businesses are grappling with. We are at the cusp of switching from wondering what AI can do for business and how to implement effective redesign of businesses. Currently, a pragmatic relearning of the core elements representing technology as organisational structures, business models and the reach of technology within these primary spheres is transformed, along with people (employees and customers). Hence, this AI module will be a timely primer towards these objectives. 15 Predictive Analytics This module introduces students to essential concepts of data analysis, including data types, visualisation techniques, data preprocessing, and dashboard design. Students explore statistical learning methods from a high-level perspective while gaining hands-on experience with real-world datasets. Through practical exercises and projects, learners develop critical skills for analysing and interpreting data, making data-driven decisions, and designing compelling visualisations. The module emphasizes employability by equipping students with in-demand analytical skills and encourages enterprise thinking through creative problem-solving. By engaging in experiential learning, students apply theory to practice, preparing for careers in data-driven industries. This module is key to building a solid foundation in data science and enhancing students' ability to communicate insights effectively. 15 Digital and Business Transformation This module explores the transformative impact of digital technologies on business models, driving changes in products, services, and organisational structures while automating processes. The widespread adoption of technologies such as the Internet, social media, data analytics, collaborative tools, AI, and cloud computing has revolutionised industries by removing traditional boundaries of time and geography. These innovations have fostered virtual communities of employees, customers, and suppliers, introducing new market demands. Understanding the mechanics and scale of this change is central to digital transformation, enabling organisations to harness these technologies to improve productivity, reduce costs, and stimulate innovation. This comprises the core content of the module. 15 Responsible AI and the Governance of Emerging Technologies This module develops your ability to critically evaluate AI regulatory and governance frameworks and assess the ethical risks associated with emerging digital technologies. You will apply advanced ethical frameworks to analyse organisational challenges, appraise the consequences of algorithmic bias for responsible managerial decision‑making, and formulate evidence‑based recommendations for the ethical use of AI. Drawing on contemporary research and real‑world case studies, you will build the judgement required to guide responsible and accountable technology adoption within organisations. 15 Managing Projects Project management knowledge has improved substantially over the period through collaborative contributions from industries and academia. However, there are still incidents affecting time, cost and quality of projects all across the industries and geographical locations. This module will enable you to understand characteristics of projects, applications of project management tools and techniques. 15 Value Creation and Business Impact with AI This module equips you with the skills to identify, design, and evaluate high‑value AI opportunities in organisational settings. You will analyse business processes to uncover inefficiencies, prioritise AI use cases, and develop AI‑enhanced business model concepts that clearly articulate value creation, data needs, and workflow integration. You will build ROI and KPI models to support evidence‑based evaluation for senior stakeholders, considering costs, benefits, and risks. Throughout the module, industry insights - especially from Capgemini - guide the refinement of proposals to ensure strategic alignment, feasibility, and real‑world applicability, culminating in a live practitioner‑engaged challenge. 15 The Aston Global Advantage The Aston Global Advantage is our professional development programme that runs throughout all MSc programmes at Aston Business School. Focusing on professional development and employability, this integrated module gives you the opportunity to identify, develop and apply the key transferrable skills you will gain throughout the year. 15 Applied Research Methods and Skills 15 Read more » Dissertation stage modules In the dissertation stage you will study the following core modules: Module Title Credits Dissertation/Research project The research project offers a unique opportunity for you to take the initiative and dive deep into a specific topic, fostering personal and academic growth. Building on the foundational knowledge gained in the taught portion of the programme, this module sharpens essential analytical and academic skills for lifelong learning in today's dynamic business landscape. By conducting independent empirical or theoretical research, you gain a deeper understanding of their chosen subject and contribute to the field. Additionally, this module serves as a stepping stone for those considering further research degrees. There is also the possibility of working on a live project provided by Capgemini or other external organisations, under the joint supervision of an Aston University member of staff and a practitioner from the organisation. 45 Read more » Programme outcomes On successful completion of both the taught and dissertation stage, you will be able to: Critically evaluate AI technologies, data-driven methods, and digital transformation frameworks to determine appropriate AI-enabled solutions for complex business challenges. Critically analyse organisational culture, stakeholder dynamics, and human factors to formulate evidence-based strategies for people-centred digital transformation. Create AI-informed redesigns of business operations to produce measurable improvements in efficiency, decision quality, or service delivery. Work effectively in teams to communicate, manage and deliver projects professionally. Appraise ethical risks, governance requirements and societal implications linked to AI use within contemporary organisations. Demonstrate advanced capability to guide organisational change that supports successful business transformation. Create, interpret, and synthesise AI-generated and evidence-based insights to support senior decision-makers in strategic planning, operational improvement, and AI-enabled organisational transformation. Undertake independent research by formulating well-defined research questions, critically evaluating and applying appropriate research techniques, and drawing informed conclusions and recommendations. Read more » We may update our courses to reflect best practices and academic developments. If we do, we’ll let you know of any changes at the earliest opportunity by updating our course webpages. If you have already received an offer, we’ll write to you directly to let you know of the changes. Entry requirements One of the following: 2:2 (lower second-class honours) degree or equivalent Equivalent overseas degree recognised by Aston University (see international students tab below for more information) Additional requirements International students Extensive work experience Subject specific requirements Applicants must also provide evidence of Mathematics - C/4 or above at GCSE (or equivalent) You will also need to provide: A professional reference If you are a current student or recent graduate (within the last 2-3 years), we will ask for an academic reference If you are currently employed and not a recent graduate, we will ask for a professional reference An official academic transcript of your university grades to date A completed application form. Read more » Aston University is a diverse, close community and welcomes international students on many of our postgraduate programmes. Students from over 120 countries choose to study with us every year. Based in the centre of Birmingham, Aston is not only a great place to study but also a great place to live. Qualifications in your country For details of equivalent qualifications in your country, use our area pages below: Africa Americas Australia North East Asia Europe Middle East and North Africa South Asia South East Asia Western and Central Asia English language requirements Applicants whose first language is not English will be required to provide evidence of an English language qualification. English language requirements How to apply Aston University provides a range of opportunities for international students to join our community and study on our campus. A key part of our strategy is our relationships with teaching partners, providing multiple pathways to Aston. Aston’s professional work placements can improve your chance of securing a graduate job. Placements give you experience, confidence and opportunities and, as an Aston student, you’ll be better prepared for your future career. One of the great things about Aston is our focus on employability. Our close links with businesses, industries and professions make this possible. Find out more about applying Pathway programmes If you don’t meet our entry requirements, we have a range of pathway programmes offered by our partner, ONCAMPUS Aston, which you can complete to progress onto one of our degrees. Read more » We recognise the value of extensive professional experience. If you do not have the academic qualifications but have extensive and relevant professional experience and a proven ability to succeed, we would welcome your application. The information contained on this website details the typical entry requirements for this course for the most commonly offered qualifications. Applicants with alternative qualifications may wish to enquire with the relevant admissions teams prior to application whether or not their qualifications are deemed acceptable. For less commonly encountered qualifications this will be judged on a case-by-case basis in consultation with the academic admissions tutor. Read more » Speak to our Admissions Team If you have any questions about the application process please get in touch with our postgraduate admissions team: Email: pgadmissions@aston.ac.uk Call: 0121 204 3200 (Please note this line is open Monday-Friday between 09:30-16:30) Read our guide to applying Meet your programme director Dr Leonidas Anastasakis Programme Director, MSc AI for Business Transformation If you have any questions about the course or modules you will be studying, you can get in touch via email and I will be happy to answer your queries. Get in touch Fees and scholarships Course fees UK students (2027/28) Annual tuition fees: £14,000 International students (2027/28) Annual tuition fees: £25,500 The duration of this programme is set out at the top of this course page and you will be responsible for the payment of an annual tuition fee in each of these years. The University reserves the right to increase tuition fees annually in accordance with its Terms and Conditions . This means that your total tuition fee may be higher than stated above, but your total tuition fee will never increase by more than 6% year on year. An increase in fees will allow the University to cover the increased costs of delivering the course and ensure it is able to maintain high standards of education and facilities. More information on fees The United Kingdom government has confirmed that European Union (EU), other European Economic Area (EEA) and Swiss nationals commencing academic courses in England from August 2021 will no longer be charged the same tuition rates as UK students. Tuition fees for students are reviewed annually and may increase in subsequent years in line with inflation linked to the Retail Price Index (RPI) to take account of the University’s increased costs of delivering the Programme. Any such increase shall always be in accordance with the law. When undertaking a placement year, a placement year fee applies. Fees and funding Scholarships At Aston University we are committed to supporting the most talented and hardworking students to achieve their potential by providing a range of scholarships to help lower tuition and living costs. Explore scholarships for UK students Explore scholarships for international students Assessment The programme will be assessed through a combination of written and oral examinations, class tests, individual and group coursework, projects, presentations and practical assessments. Career prospects The World Economic Forum’s Future of Jobs report (2023) states that AI and machine learning specialists, together with data analytics and digital transformation specialists, are the most prominent emerging roles. Furthermore, a 2024 report by PwC “AI Jobs Barometer” found that workers who build the skills to harness AI will be more valuable to employers and generate more value to an organisation. Graduates can pursue roles such as: Digital Transformation Consultant Change Manager AI Strategy Analyst Technical Project Lead Business Transformation Manager Data-Driven Innovation Consultant These roles demand a combination of analytical, project management, and communication skills alongside a robust understanding of AI applications within business contexts. When completed, the course will allow you to support communication efforts, assess change impact, manage projects, and facilitate AI integration into business processes. Our graduates achieve amazing things all over the world – whether it’s setting up their own businesses, landing jobs with high profile organisations, or making real differences within their communities. Hear from our graduates Be part of our community Once you have joined us at Aston University, you’ll always be part of our community, even beyond graduation. Alumni services Frequently asked questions Why study AI for Business Transformation at Aston University? Studying MSc AI for Business Transformation prepares you to lead AI-driven change where it matters most - within organisations. This industry-co-created programme, endorsed by Capgemini, uniquely approaches AI through a management and transformation lens rather than a purely technical one, aligning people, processes and technology to deliver real business impact. You will develop future-ready skills in leadership, change management, analytics and AI strategy, grounded in ethical and responsible AI practice. Through applied learning, industry engagement and the opportunity to work on live business projects, the course equips you to meet the growing global demand for professionals who can translate AI innovation into sustainable organisational value. What is the ‘Aston Global Advantage’? Embedded in all our masters degrees, this assessed module aims to develop professional and personal transferrable skills relevant to any workplace and create a bridge between the degree and the world of work. The Aston Global Advantage Why should I study my postgraduate degree at Aston University? There are lots of benefits of studying a postgraduate degree at Aston University. Watch this video from MBA student, Monique, who talks about just a few of them: Is Birmingham a good place to study? Our campus is based in the centre of Birmingham, the youngest major city in Europe and a great place to live, work and study. Great music and entertainment with a vibrant nightlife. Bars, clubs, pubs, live music, festivals, concerts. Whatever your tastes, there's something here for everyone. Fantastic food. Birmingham's diverse community means you can try anything from the famous Balti triangle, the Chinese Quarter, high street chains, halal and vegan food, and Michelin-star dining. World-class shopping. The Bullring and Grand Central is a shopper's paradise. From the world's biggest Primark to luxury brands at the Mailbox. Arts and culture. Museums, galleries, theatres, concerts and Birmingham's art collection is as wide as it is impressive - not to be missed. Green, open spaces. One of the greenest cities in Europe, Birmingham has hundreds of publicly accessible parks and green spaces across the city. Sporting action. Birmingham has some of the most exciting venues for watching or participating in sport in the UK. Discover Birmingham What will my timetable look like? We understand how important it is to know your timetable in advance for planning around work, childcare, or other responsibilities. Here's some basic guidance on what to expect regarding your student timetable. Full-time programmes As a rough estimate, full-time postgraduate students in the College of Business and Social Sciences should expect to spend about 12-15 hours per week in lectures and on-campus seminars. This is in addition to independent study, and there may be additional guided learning activities during certain weeks. The exact distribution of these hours will vary depending on your course and module choices. Part-time programmes Part-time students will have fewer weekly on-campus hours compared to full-time students. This reduction is proportional to the number of modules you're enrolled in. Timetable availability Complete timetables are usually released shortly before the start of your programme. This timing is necessary to ensure that we accommodate all course requirements and that rooms are allocated based on the number of students likely to enrol on each programme. We aim to provide these timetables as early as possible, to assist you in your planning. As your induction week approaches, you will be sent more information about your timetable via email, and you will be able to access your timetable by logging into MyAstonPortal. For any further queries or information regarding your timetable, you can reach out to your programme director or the Student Support team. Online/distance learning programmes The above information also applies to students enrolled in online/distance learning programmes. Please note that both full-time and part-time distance learning students are still required to attend scheduled synchronous learning sessions. MyAstonPortal What can I get involved in at Aston Business School? At Aston Business School, you will dive into a dynamic blend of innovative learning and hands-on experiences. With our acclaimed triple-crown accreditation, we offer you academic excellence and a track record of producing successful graduates. Located in Birmingham, the UK's vibrant second city, Aston Business School provides you with a culturally rich environment and superb connectivity. You will benefit from real-world business engagements, international study opportunities and entrepreneur support programmes like BSEEN and Pitchfest. You can also engage in practical consultancy at the Aston Business Clinic and collaborate with global peers in events such as the Maastricht Case Competition or the Universities Business Challenge . Our partnership with The Prince’s Trust, alongside a range of student clubs including TEDx and Enactus further enriches your learning experience. Discover more Hello, what would you like to ask us?
